It's the last summer before the end of high school, and Kyohei Kashiro feels lost. Should he get a job or apply to college? Live locally or move to the big city? Or most terrifyingly of all. what if Kyohei says yes? The questions feel too big for Eiji to hold in. It's time to confess to the guy who stole his heart all those years ago.

It's the last summer before the end of high school, and Kyohei's and Eiji's lives are about to change forever. Change is abrupt. Change is scary. But most of all, change is magical. 207051.description:
Diana married the elderly Marquis Casper for certain reasons and lived a peaceful, happy married life. But Casper suddenly died in a carriage accident, leaving Diana a young widow. Yet the will that was opened revealed a shocking condition: the inheritance of the title and estate depended on “one year of marriage between Albert and Diana.” To honor the late Casper's trust, Diana accepted the contractual marriage, vowing to watch over Albert until he could stand alone as the heir. Meanwhile, Albert, who knew Diana only through rumors calling her a “wicked woman,” suspected her motives were for the inheritance and treated her coldly. Yet, as Diana selflessly supported him despite her own pain, Albert's heart gradually began to waver. He found himself drawn to her... Crossed hearts, past wounds, and a state conspiracy over the inheritance intertwine, propelling the story toward an unexpected turn...

When she awoke, she found herself back on her wedding day, two years prior.

“This time, I will survive—”

Swearing this vow, Raffy planned to divorce and flee. Yet the once-indifferent Cyrus, though bewildered by her change, found himself drawn to her. Eventually, they shared a night together, and a faint spark of affection began to grow within Raffy. But fearing her heart would be betrayed again, she carried out her escape. Just then, however, she discovered she was pregnant, and Raffy resolved to protect this new life. Then, two and a half years later, balancing childcare and work while waiting for the statute of limitations on marriage to expire, Raffy is confronted by Cyras, now acting like a completely different person, showering her with overwhelming affection. Inukai is a girl who is like a dog: she's affable, lively and straightforward. Nekoi is an attractive boy who is like a cat: shy, quiet and dedicated to his hobbies. This is their love story.

207089.description:
The dark blade Gruhorn, constant companion to heroes throughout the ages. Knights, rebels, and slayers—all became legend wielding this sentient blade. But, centuries after being claimed by the first hero, Gruhorn winds up in the clutches of his descendant: a greedy, greasy, bratty lout of a first prince. Even worse: when the prince falls onto the blade, Gruhorn becomes him! But is this new body a prison, or a chance for the legendary blade to become a hero himself?

(Source: Tapas)

207090.description:
After serving the kingdom for 300 years as the wolf goddess, Lauren is brutally abandoned once she is no longer deemed useful. But instead of a death sentence, she is secretly given a second chance to live as a normal beastkin. And like all female beastkin, she soon experiences her first heat, which results in a spontaneous night with a serpent stranger by the name of Alexander. Although Lauren wishes to put this mistake behind her, Alexander is desperate to find the wolfish woman he has now marked as his mate...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Ordered into a political marriage with a northern tribe, Princess Eun-Woo wanders out in distress and encounters a massive tiger with an injured paw. As she treats the tiger’s wound, she tells the tiger that he may “eat her” out of despair. Baek Hwi, the king of the tiger clan, is lost for words but is ignited with a different kind of hunger. Unable to forget her, the tiger king begins relentlessly pursuing Eun-Woo, determined to make her his mate…

Fumiya was troubled by his sex life with his wife. Though he adored her, he simply couldn't respond during sex. The couple had no children and suffered daily pressure from relatives. Then one day, the government abruptly tore them apart, forcing each to cohabit with a 'new partner'. It was state-sanctioned adultery, implemented as part of measures to combat the declining birth rate!

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

207107.description:
Shiba, the strongest man in another world, is not good with women. However, he is prophesied to become the parent of a "Hero" who will save the world. This prophecy causes all the women in the other world to frantically target Shiba...! Fearing this, Shiba enlists the help of his childhood friend, the saint Somali, and sets off for their version of the other world, "Japan." The first person Shiba meets in Japan is Mike, a high school girl who aspires to become the god of matchmaking! This is a crazy harem romantic comedy in which all the characters are working hard to find a happy marriage!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

Liz, the daughter of a margrave, is told that she could never be loved, and has her engagement called off by her former fiancé, a baron by the name of Physalis. After years of facing ab*se from her family and mysterious pains, Liz is finally forced her out of the estate with her family set on offering her up to as a bride to the "cursed duke"... formerly a hero of the kingdom, Lord Rishin. Rumor has it that he himself had an engagement called off due to his apparent violent nature, but things turn out to be quite the opposite...! After years of never finding someone to understand the pain they've carried, the two set out to find true happiness!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

After years of friendship and one reckless night, Hae-In ghosted A-list actor Woo-Hyun. Three years later, she’s the writer of his new drama—and his dirty secret living one floor away. As the lines between script and reality blur, can they navigate friendship, romance, and the mess of mixing work with personal life?

207118.description:
Dorothea, the daughter of a viscount, is compared to her selfish but beautiful younger sister, who has the title of "Saint," and has lived her life despised by both her family and those around her. One day, her younger sister insults the princess of an allied country, calling her "animal-like," which escalates into an international incident. Dorothea goes alone to apologize to the beast-man country of Rezanard on her sister's behalf, but...

207119.description:
Viola, living alone in a remote countryside, accidentally rescues and treats a badly wounded man named Caliban. The two feel an inexplicable attraction accompanied by a sweet scent, leading to a passionate first night together... Afterwards, Caliban suddenly vanishes without a trace. Left alone, unaware of Caliban's whereabouts, Viola leaves her hometown to seek work as a maid. In the basement of her new workplace, she discovers Caliban, imprisoned in the form of a beast...

A tale of fated love disguised as chance—between the ‘Calibans’, a monstrous clan with latent beastly instincts, and Viola, the half-human who alone can calm them.

(Source: Naver, translated)

207121.description:
“Let's date. For a month, intensely.”

Chae-Won learns that her identical twin sister, separated since childhood, has been forced into divorce by her husband and treated with contempt by her in-laws. After her sister becomes a vegetable in a traffic accident, Chae-Won devises a plan to impersonate her sister and exact revenge on her family. However, Yu-Geon, a blind date she stood up due to her sister's situation, accidentally learns of her plan. Needing to date Chae-Won to inherit property, Yu-Geon proposes a contract relationship...!

(Source: Naver, translated)

207123.description:
Yu-Jeong, abandoned once by her birth parents and twice by her adoptive parents. Ji-Woon, unable to believe in love because of the many mothers who left him. Two people who never knew their mothers become a legal couple for the sake of the precious child they want to protect. The story of how they start as a couple on paper and become a real family.

(Source: Naver, translated)

207124.description:
The Monster Who Fell in Love with Its Prey, and the Child Who Fell in Love with That Monster.

A blue-gray monster born in the forest. He discovers a child abandoned in his territory and brings it to his lair. Not to care for it—but to devour it. The child, Fernin, survived under that monster. Years later, the grown child stands before the monster once more... The monster who came to love the child that was its prey, and the child who grew fond of such a monster. Time begins to flow again for the two reunited after over a decade.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

207125.description:
Yoshida earns a living solely through dubious part-time jobs. And the reason? He gets paid an exorbitant amount. For one such job, Yoshida's asked to live in a house with a history. As the story goes, the previous family of three who lived there committed a group suicide. What could have possibly sent the family over the edge? When Yoshida discovers the daughter's picture diary, inexplicable facts come to light... Follow Yoshida and his fellow forum denizens as they search for answers in these pulse-pounding tales. Just one question, will they solve the mystery first, or will you beat them to the punch?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

A demon named Adele appears before Hitsuji, a single office worker who leads a busy life! After making a contract with the demon, Hitsuji and Adele begin living together. While their life as a demon and a human may seem odd, it turns out to be surprisingly comfortable...!?

A heartwarming, laid-back comedy for all hard-working women.

On the day she transferred in, Mari witnessed a boy fall from the school's roof! Was it suicide? But there are rumors circulating about a "witch's" curse, and creepy incidents are happening one after the other around her. Mari decides "If I don't kill her, I'll be killed", however...

In addition to the title story, the 4 stories "Moebius no Yoru", "Mangetsu ga Miteita", "Kami no Te", and "Kurayami" are included. Step into the bizarre and fantastical world of Oohashi as she investigates the casual horror lurking in the everyday.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

207137.description:
“Dreams and Romance”—something everyone pursues, only to give up at the first dead-end they reach; yet, there was a man who relentlessly chased them! This is the tale of the Ryoukiou, who understands he's a loser in reality yet still pursued his dreams.

In a world teeming with magic, young Kinato yearns for adventure! But his special magic power happens to be...seitai healing?! When adventure does come his way, will Kinato be able to use his minor healing abilities to become a hero?!

207151.description:
Shusuke Kinoshita is 31 years old. After being dumped by his younger boyfriend of five years, he drowns his sorrows by drinking alone in a park. Unbeknownst to him, the park is known as a hookup spot for guys, and it's not long before a young, attractive man named Eito invites Shusuke to join him at a motel. Uncharacteristically for him, Shusuke decides to accept his invitation. With the hopes of changing himself and forgetting about his ex, Shusuke spends the night with Eito...!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

207153.description:
For some reason, no more boys are being born, and humanity faces an apocalyptic crisis. Amidst rampant trafficking of boys and the establishment of shelters to protect them, people continue living in their own ways. Jessica, an actress popular for her sophisticated image, has Valentine, the boss of a human trafficking cartel, as her sponsor. One day, Jin, who claims to be her younger brother, appears before her—a woman who lacked nothing and felt no regret...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Jia Gang, the greatest swordsman of Joseon, fails to avenge his master and dies, descending to the underworld. Possessing a special soul, Jiagang is promised a chance for revenge by the King of the Underworld and takes on the path of a Grim Reaper who captures evil spirits.

(Source: Naver, translated)

207163.description:
Lowena, a sweet but terminally ill orphan girl, holds a secret: her world exists within a novel, and only one person is capable of finding a cure for her otherwise untreatable disease. Unfortunately, that person happens to be the Duke of Somerset, the ruthless and obsessive male lead of the story. With her days numbered, Lowena decides to infiltrate his household with a genius plan... become family to the widowed duke and his nephew and win their hearts before the illness stops hers!

(Source: Tapas)

207164.description:
The manga's story begins when ordinary high school girl Chiyo Watanabe wakes up one day into a fantasy world, inhabiting the body of a Venessa, a lady of a ducal family. Though she thinks at first that she can enjoy the aristocratic high life, the discovery of her family's lordly sum of debts puts an end to that. Her last hope lies in her apparent betrothal to Alfred, the king of the Kingdom of Willand. Though the king does not seem to enamored with marriage, one year of a false relationship may buy Venessa the money she needs.

(Source: Anime News Network)

207166.description:
"Why are you so okay with my blood touching you...?" Blanca, who works as a slave, meets a handsome young man named Vincent while on the run. When Vincent's blood runs down Blanca's cheek after he is injured, he cannot hide his surprise and confusion. No one should be able to accept their own cursed blood unscathed - Blanca, who grew up as a slave, and Vincent, the lonely "Duke of Death." This is the story of love that these two discover for the first time.

(Source: Gentosha, translated)

207167.description:
Rose Adel is the eldest daughter of a marquess. She absolutely adores her betrothed, the third prince Licht, and has devoted herself to becoming the princess consort he deserves. But then, she witnesses him spending time with another young lady and fondly gazing at her. While deeply hurt, Rose cannot help but wish happiness upon her beloved, and realizes the only way she can support his relationship is to play the role of evil villainess wholeheartedly! And with her fiance's older brother Richard offering his help, it's time for Rose to wipe away her tears and step up to the grand stage! Will Rose be able to make her mark as the greatest villain in history?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

207169.description: Seo Jun-Kyung, a veteran prosecutor who uncovered corruption among the privileged class, was falsely accused of sexual assault and murdered in a disguised suicide… Thought dead, he awakens in the body of his enemy's nephew, a trainee prosecutor named Kim Seo-Jin. After being reborn, he gains the ability to read past memories, "psychometry." Using this ability, he begins to destroy corrupt politicians and businesspeople, as well as the enemies who drove him to his death.

207170.description:
"I wanted him so badly that I would have given up everything for him... And in the end, I did." After losing her crown, her children, and her life to the man she loved, Princess Medea finds herself back in her 17-year-old body. Now aware of the treacherous alliance between her ex-lover and her uncle, who have been scheming for the throne and fueling a rebellion, she's determined to save her kingdom and seize the reins of her future. Can the princess escape a tragic death and reclaim her destiny?

(Source: Tapas)

207171.description:
Ordered by the king to end a century-long feud between two families, Joo Ha-Yeong is forced to marry Yeon Moo-Eun, a man surrounded by nasty rumors. Surprisingly, after a brief misunderstanding on their wedding night, they quickly form a warm relationship as wife and husband. However, as their bond grows, Ha-Yeong starts questioning the rumors regarding her husband, who hardly seems like the wayward hooligan he is described as. Is Moo-Eun truly a man to be feared? Or is he a man who deserves to be loved?

(Source: Tappytoon)

207175.description:
One day, red threads appeared on the fingers of all humans worldwide. Since those bound by that thread were destined for lasting relationships, it became known as the "red thread of fate," and a new era dawned where thread-based romance became the norm. While all this was happening, a red thread suddenly appeared on the finger of the protagonist, Tsumugi, who, incidentally, just happens to despise "thread-based love"....

Suddenly, people's homes began connecting to another world, and incidents proliferated where residents were brutally slaughtered by invading monsters ("Invaders"). Having lost someone dear right before her eyes, Eiko Satou dedicates her entire life to revenge against the beasts.

207189.description:
Childhood friends Shingetsu and Asahi are attending a festival when an angel appears. The angel smiles, unfurls her bloodstained wings, then rips into the throats of onlookers. As the friends’ peaceful island home becomes a slaughterhouse, they realize the angel’s true identity—she’s a vampire! Shingetsu soon learns that he’s one of the Seven Luminaries who seek to eliminate the vampiric threat. Can he wield his newfound power to save humanity from a bitter, bloody end?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

207190.description:
Ryoichi Aikawa, an ordinary high school boy who’s crazy about fishing, helps the school’s Madonna, Misa Watanabe, when she’s being bothered by guys trying to pick her up by the seaside.

After that, for some reason, Watanabe starts asking about his weekend plans every week and ends up making plans with him. Secretly meeting every weekend, the two slowly at an incredibly slow pace begin to close the distance between them…?

A frustratingly sweet seaside romantic comedy featuring a single-minded, love-offensive JK and an unbelievably dense, iron-wall boy!

207193.description:
There was a nameless warrior who devoted his life to guarding and serving Cheon Mu-ryang, the eldest young master of the Cheon Clan. In the end, he was betrayed by Cheon Mu-ryang and met his death. But when he opened his eyes again, he found himself reborn as the very man who killed him: Cheon Mu-ryang, the infamous mad dog and eldest son of the Cheon Clan. With his memories of the past, his martial arts, and a cold, calculating judgment, he dons the mask of a scoundrel and steps into the clan’s internal struggles for power. From within, he begins to save the Cheon Clan from destruction... To rewrite the future itself.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: Becoming the Cheon Clan's Mad Dog
I Became the Scoundrel of the Cheon Family

207194.description:
Born from the weaponization of nuclear fusion technology, the superhuman weapons known as Defiers (D-fire) plunged the world into war—an apocalypse that wiped out 30% of humanity. The survivors came to loathe the Defiers, branding them the architects of extinction and calling them “Enders.”Theo, the sole survivor among the Enders, lived for 30 years under the surveillance of the Ainex Alliance, his core removed, passing his days as an ordinary family man. But when the anti-nuclear terrorist organization “Zero Core” attacks, Theo loses his wife—and his daughter Louise vanishes without a trace. The peace he struggled to protect is shattered in an instant.Vowing revenge, Theo reawakens the forbidden power he sealed away three decades ago to reclaim his daughter. Standing against Zero Core’s vast conspiracy and a world steeped in prejudice, the lonely battle of the last Ender begins.

(Source: Naver, translated)

207195.description:

"Well... regardless of my opinion, the law is the law. Hence, Usami-san's opinion is already representative of the entire Legal Department." He's my subordinate who's always there to support me. At the same time, he's my fiancé who's living with me. However, he's super sadistic and loves to see me crying and being humiliated in bed.

"Why are you crying? You tried to provoke me into doing this to you, didn't you? Before we began dating, you told me you used to masturbate violently like this and drank so much to relieve your stress, right? Ah... You're adorable..."

I was made to squirt and felt jolts of electricity up my spine. As I was about to lose my consciousness, I could see Taizou-kun laughing at me and mocking me...

207196.description:
Koharu is a petite and thoughtful administrative assistant in the office. Katsuura is a big, hard-nosed sales rep. These two elite employees from different departments usually don't get along... Until one day late at work, when Katsuura finds Koharu eating by herself in the office, with a massive bento spread across her desk — very different from her cute image...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

207198.description:
Otoha, who goes by the stage name "Otoya," is a beta and the frontman of the popular rock band DAY BREAK. Kurashiro Yutaka is the no-nonsense alpha who acts as the band's manager. For years, the two have been caught up in a no-strings-attached relationship—their secondary sexes making it impossible for them to form a deeper bond as mates. Each man has kept their true feelings hidden, but when Kurashiro suspects that Otoha's heart belongs to someone else, his anxiety and possessiveness go into overdrive! Will this unlikely pair be able to defy the bonds of fate and become something more?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

207199.description:
In this world, there are invisible beings called "hyoma." They dwell in the darkness of people's hearts, eventually taking their lives. To protect people from these dark beings, there is one man who continues to exorcise demons alone... An occult battle fantasy featuring a hero who is both an exorcist and a doctor begins NOW!!

(Source: Silent Manga Audition, edited)

207200.description: The gothic mystery novels center on Kunori Orizue, a beautiful and mysterious girl who calls herself a "witch," when all manner of mysterious and questionable incidents happen in her vicinity. She reunites with a childhood friend named Takumi, who gets drawn into all the incidents around Kunori.

207201.description:
A small, family-run dry cleaner bustles with customers, welcoming those feeling a bit lost in life. A dress belonging to a woman betrayed by her fiancé, mourning clothes for a daughter who lost her mother—each garment is cared for with love. When they slip into these reborn clothes… it feels like their hearts have also been gently washed clean. Their spirits lift just a little, and they find the strength to move forward.

What will the next customer entrust to “Cleaning Kujira”?

(Source: Koisuru Soiree, translated)

207203.description:
Midnight Shadow tells the story of Alice, a young woman plagued with the ability to see people’s true selves through their shadows. Barney, a mysterious eccentric enters her life showing a fascination in her seldom few have, when a trip to a coffee shop goes horribly wrong.

(Source: Silent Manga Audition)

title.english: Midnight Shadow
title.native: ミッドナイト・シャドー

207204.description:
Lewis, a masochist and passionate omega with cross-dressing tendencies, suffers from the trauma of being raped during his college days. Though he lost much—including being disowned by his family and suffering deep psychological wounds—from that rape, he lives on as a paid doctor, unbroken. Then one day, the bastard Camillo, the one who raped him and sent his once-promising life spiraling into ruin, is found injured, collapsed near his home?!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

207205.description:
Yang-Hui, who had secretly loved Tae-Young since childhood. Following Tae-Young's father's dying wish to take good care of his son even if he wasn't around, he never even dreamed of confessing and distanced himself from Tae-Young to sort out his feelings. Just as his constant tension and avoidance during Tae-Young's military service began to ease... One day, he wakes up to find himself completely naked, sleeping next to Tae-Young...?!

“No, we can't do this...!”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

207206.description:
Volleyball star Oh Leo never forgot his first love, Wu Eden. Years later, he follows a familiar melody into an ice rink, only to find the former figure skating prodigy herself. While Leo is all sunshine and relentless affection, Eden has built a cold wall around her heart. But during a private skating lesson, the ice begins to melt as she notices Leo's powerful, athletic physique. When a playful scuffle sends them sliding across the ice, Eden realizes Leo is carrying more than just a torch for her, he’s packing a "bat" that’s ready for the big leagues. Driven by sudden temptation, she lures him into the office to see if his stamina on the court translates to the sheets.

(Source: Lezhin US)

207207.description:
Princess Helen Ariel, weary from repeated assassination attempts. Despite warnings from those around her, she appoints the notoriously brutal mercenary Beled Leon as her bodyguard. Trusting only his abilities, she keeps him by her side, yet Helen finds herself facing even greater threats to her life...

Can she truly trust this man?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Momoko is completely clueless when it comes to love. When her uncle arranges yet another marriage interview, she reluctantly agrees to a second meeting with a man she barely remembers. But the moment Hisato walks in, she's completely caught off guard. How could she have forgotten someone so handsome? Unfortunately, good looks don't make up for his incredibly rude attitude. Put off by his attitude, it seems things are doomed from the start! That is, until Hisato leaves her speechless with a sudden proposal!

A strong-willed rich girl and a carefree heir are getting married without even a single date?!

It's the spring of my second year of high school. I meet my childhood friend, a boy and a girl, and a transfer student. Our story, which is still colorless, begins to take on a gentle tone. A new coming-of-age story written by Hagino Makoto, the author of Nettaigyo wa Yuki ni Kogareru!

The girlfriend waving at me from the sidelines of a buffet, the email that said "I'll break all your joints," the old friend I was with while "waiting to be punched" by a coworker... 207220.description:
Han Segeun was a restless kid with a life and family too ordinary to satisfy him. He chased speed and trouble, wishing he could break free from the dull days ahead. Then, a vampire granted that wish by slaughtering everyone he loved. Saved by Sylvester, the excommunicated Vampire Lord Hunter, Segeun enters the world of the mad moon, a hidden war where vampires prey on humans and hunters kill for cash. Can Segeun live long enough for revenge, or will the night take him like it took his family?

The Kingdom of Hyeonhwa. A nation where the Four Guardian Deities, led by Hyeon-Mu, ruled alongside the human king, achieving thousands of years of prosperity. Jin-Heon, seated upon the throne of the court, seeks to seize the power of the divine beast Mok-Hyeon and establish a realm ruled solely by humans. However, Jin-Heon is deprived of the moment to take Mok-Hyeon's power due to the existence of Jae-Hyeon. Yeon-Hwi is a young man who passed the highest imperial examination, a talented scholar. Yet, his father, displeased that the illegitimate son Yeon-Hwi surpassed the legitimate heir, poisons him. Having lived his entire life seeking his father's recognition, Yeon-Hwi, on the brink of death, harbors a hatred as fierce as his desire to be loved. And Mok-Hyeon answers that hatred. In a world where guides have no human rights, the only being Shio must protect is his younger brother, Ter. Having struggled to escape the fate of being a ‘selected one’—little better than an Esper sex slave—Shio heads to the Esper house, a place akin to hell, when his brother becomes selected.

The arrogant Erutio violates Shio without restraint, cruelly holding him captive. Time passes, and Shio grows accustomed to this life. Days flow by neither happy nor unhappy, but Erutio seems oddly off.

After starting with sex, now demanding a kiss? How on earth am I supposed to appease this utterly capricious Esper?

Lim Tae-San, the second-in-command of the Waryong Association, clings to life after a traffic accident and possesses the body of Prosecutor Kang Ba-Run, who lies in a coma. Upon awakening, Tae-San discovers suspicious circumstances surrounding his own death. Using his connections and combat skills from his past life, along with his present intellect and wealth, he sets out to uncover the hidden conspiracy behind his death….

On her way home from school, Suzuna stops by a shrine to see the beautiful double cherry blossoms in full bloom. From that moment on, Suzuna and Sarasa hit it off, but as they continue to be chased by the biker gang members every day, a major incident soon ensues that involves the two of them!

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

207243.description:
On her first date with her boyfriend, Hasegawa, Misono, a second-year high school student, meets Ruiko, who has the looks of a handsome young man. Hasegawa takes her to a fashion show, where Ruiko is on stage as a model. She is a friend of her brother's, and is a lesbian who is dating a woman named Susan. "I detest vulgar men."

Salivia is a blossoming aristocratic lady who refuses to bend the knee to any man. She has never known love, but she must find a fiancé by the time she turns 17 or her grandmother will choose for her. One night, Salivia encounters the "cunning knight Uld," who, to her shock, is a romanceable character in a dating game from her previous life!

Leticia, the daughter of a count, remembers dying at the age of 30 in her past life... but now her engagement to the prince is being called off! What's more, she may have sprained her ankle... but Prince Liam is adamant about helping her. Now, with the sudden opportunity to be this close to the man she's admired for so long, and the kind words coming from the generous Prince Liam, a chance like no other is upon Leticia. Will she have the courage to tell him what she really wants to say?!

(Source: MangaPlaza, edited)

207248.description:
"Your housekeeping skills are 20 points. And as a wife, you're a zero."

Since Saki married her husband, Naoya, he's completely changed. He's become a manipulative man who constantly judges and "scores" her. But for the sake of her daughter, Saki puts up with his controlling behavior.

To rub salt in the wound, Naoya praises their neighbor, Madoka, as a "100-point woman." When Saki discovers he's having an affair with her, she sets out to get revenge on her toxic husband and his arrogant mistress!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

207249.description:
"That's why this is your punishment, my lady"

One night, she found herself embraced by a mysterious man. In an unfamiliar room, "the other me" continues to slumber in the bed. No matter how vivid the scene was, she always thought it was just a dream. However, from that night onwards, once she fell asleep, he would appear and reach out to her as she sleep. The pleasures given in her dreams...

(Source: DLsite, translated)

207252.description:
In a certain country, in a certain region, deep in the peaceful mountains, there was a tanuki caught in a trap. A kind-hearted young man who happened to pass by set the tanuki free.

"I’m the tanuki you saved. I’ve come to repay the favor." And so, the tanuki he rescued transformed into a human and returned to repay his debt of gratitude. The young man, who calls himself Kagehisa, quickly grows fond of the cute tanuki and, as part of the “repayment,” impulsively asks for something a bit naughty. Though his request is refused, he finds the tanuki’s reactions to his teasing adorable and enjoys the time they spend together, so he asks him to come by now and then just to talk…?

A slightly naughty yet endlessly peaceful and heartwarming BL story about a human and a shape-shifting tanuki brought together by a bond of gratitude!

There is a prestigious private academy with a championship sports club... and behind that sports clubs, are the female managers who devote themselves to its members. In the age of warring states, with many warlords vying for power, Oda Nobunaga was killed at Honnoji Temple just before his unification with the whole country. This is a never-before-seen portrayal of him! Who was the real mastermind behind the Honnoji Incident?

207265.description:
Satsuki has been dating her boyfriend Itsuki for three years. They now live together and are considering marriage, but it's far from smooth sailing. While she is struggling with that at home, one day Satsuki discovers at a company barbeque that Itsuki has been cheating on her with her coworker, Kana. So, when he asked her out, it was just to lighten the mood when she was feeling down... or so she thought. But it seems like Fujisaki meant what he said. Nothing can hold back the feelings coming from this body, squirming, melting away into pleasure... the good-looking guy in the office shoots a charming look my way, and everything gets hot and messy from there... Kotone Sakura is a project planner as a game developer, and she takes her work very seriously. Then there's Ren Shinoyama, her junior at the company. He's not the most fashionable sort, and seems a little reserved, but is a total genius when it comes to project planning. He's already set to have his newest proposal go forward, and already feels way ahead in the office compared to Kotone...

One day, during an after-work gathering, Kotone gets drunk and finds herself all over Ren, then the two go back to his place?!

And while she works hard every day and desperately wishes to defy her fate, there isn't much time left until her 16th birthday when the oracle will make itself known. "If you're okay with me, I'll sleep with you."

But just when she's about to pass out at work, the ace from sales, Hidaka, comes to her rescue! Nene feels so relaxed in Hidaka's arms, without thinking, she blurts out that she wants him to sleep with her. But once the two get in the bed together, their hearts start to beat and things start to take a turn?! But there’s a twist: when she arrives at work the next day, her "bad boy" ex has turned into a perfect gentleman. Between her bad boyfriend and good ex, Su-Yeon’s life gets complicated.

As rain fell outside, a customer dressed in mourning clothes entered La Mer Bar alone. His clothes were drenched, water dripping from him. The bartender, Shimura, was captivated. Just as Shimura was pondering this, the customer ordered a second drink: "A Ghost Dog." 'If anyone ever orders this cocktail, watch out. That guy might be a real dog ghost.' Jeong-Guk Woo delivers mail as a postman in a post-apocalyptic world and dreams of riding the subway. When headquarters announces plans to revive it, Jeong-Guk is eager to join, but government worker Yong-Han Cho personally bans him, citing the lack of dangerous missions in Jeong-Guk’s file. Infuriated by the snub, Jeong-Guk accepts the deadly task of delivering a letter to the AAA, a militarized area infamous for refusing mail. Once he arrives, he discovers the letter is addressed to Yong-Han's sisters, who beg him to help them escape. Will he follow the postman rules, or risk everything to help them?!

(Source: WEBTOON)

A marriage interview with your childhood friend who's now a professional shogi player?!

Hana has always dreamed of getting married, but she just can't seem to find a boyfriend. It's been ten years since she last saw her childhood friend, Issei, and somehow they've reunited at a marriage interview?! The gentle Issei that she once knew is now called the "Demon Sergeant" with his intimidating aura! Hana is unsure of the proposal after seeing how he's changed, but when she realizes he's still as awkward and as kind as ever, she cuts to the chase and confesses to Issei!

"Can we please date with marriage in mind?"

Lavis Vindica, son of the Demon King Gamudair, was exiled for a bloodbath that shook the Demon Realm. After being sentenced to inhabit the frail body of Jung Minho, a human teen left comatose by a pack of school bullies, Lavis is fueled by rage and desperate to find a way home. But he quickly discovers a chilling truth... The mortal realm is infested with evils far more sadistic than anything he’s ever seen. Now, he must survive a world where the real monsters hide in plain sight.

(Source: Tapas)

207304.description:
"I've found you, my spring."

The Takatsukasa family is the largest conglomerate in the empire. Within their residence, there lie special gardens where all four seasons exist. These serve as a barrier, protecting the imperial capital from evil insects. The caretakers who maintain it are chosen from the four great families, each responsible for one season. Hio lost her parents when she was a child and was taken in by one of the great families, the Harusaki family. She's been bullied by the daughter of the family and is treated worse than a servant. Hio's fate changes when she plays her father's violin and is suddenly whisked away in the strong arms of Sakuto, the head of the Takatsukasa family.

"You're the only one. You're the only one who can..."

Kim Seoyeon (Song Sammi), a swindler, is chased by gangsters after a marriage scam and coincidentally hides in a church. There, she encounters a seemingly chaotic yet harmonious pastor's family. However, this place turns out to be a cult church, and the pastor is exploiting not only his followers but also his own children. Blinded by the huge church funds, Seoyeon decides to pull another scam. To do so, she digs into the pastor's family's weaknesses to dismantle them, forming relationships with everyone. However, contrary to Seoyeon's intentions, the siblings find comfort in her, gradually rally around her, and begin to revere her as their savior (Messiah), starting to confront their father. Seoyeon's plan, which started with a lie, leads to an unintended revolution(?)...

Kanon is a handsome werewolf who always finds himself in trouble with vampires, who appreciate beauty by nature. They cannot help but tempt him wherever he works. As a result, he loses his job and struggles to make money. One day, Neiro, the owner of a vampires' blood bar, talks to him. Neiro buys blood from all species. It looks shady, but Kanon decides to sell his blood to support his family. The analysis reveals that his blood matches Neiro! Neiro is allergic to all types of blood and is always starving. He happily starts to savor Kanon's blood, with his consent, of course... But at a night of full moon, Kanon suddenly turns into a different person and climbs on top of Neiro! “Your moans... sound adorable."

A fantastic boys' love about a handsome werewolf and a hungry vampire!

The world is divided into two: the ‘Moon Kingdom’ where humans live, and the ‘Sun Kingdom’ where demons dwell. Estelle, a knight of the Moon Kingdom, loses her family in a demon attack. Entangled with a strange demon girl, she is even given a terminal diagnosis. To survive, she must journey to the tower in the north. A timid knight girl, a slave boy, and a demon king turned ghost. The story of three who embark on an adventure to find life.

(Source: Naver, translated)

207317.description:
2041. Several years have passed since the development of artificial body technology, commonly known as “Mimic”.
Captain Chris Armstrong, who was seriously injured in an accident during an operation, underwent body replacement surgery and returned to the front lines... or so it seemed, but after the surgery, something felt strange about his body. When he looked at himself in the mirror, he saw a beautiful girl with soft white skin and silky hair that suited her well!
Behind the scenes of a war raging with intrigue and resentment, an impromptu unit consisting of four girl-type bodies is suddenly formed. Their name is Mimicry Girls. Shooting, hand-to-hand combat, infiltration. These specialists in all fields are given a mission: to protect the president's daughter, who is being targeted by the mysterious international criminal organization “Val Verde”.
After a cool tea time, the cute operation begins! Mimic girls and confront the world's greatest evil!. A thrilling gun action comedy brought to you by a special forces quartet in the form of girls!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

207318.description:
When the world outside is overrun by the dead, one apartment stands untouched. But inside, survival has a price—provisions traded for bodies, vows broken, and desires unleashed in the last safe place on earth.

(Source: Toomics)

207319.description:
Things get cooking right away in this dungeon epic with cheat skills and delicious dishes! Koichi Suzuki, an incorrigible lover of beastfolk and their adorably fl uffy ears, dies young after heroically saving a child. In a divine exchange, his reward is reincarnation into another world... and the ability to cook up magical beasts? Now called Thor, he must use the knowledge of his past life and newfound culinary skills to survive a world that shows mercy to no one, not even children. But just as he manages to find his footing, who should appear before him but two beastfolk on the verge of death! Thor will have to cook up a recipe for success if he wants all three of them to survive. And so begins their story of furry ears, mouthwatering cooking, and dungeon crawling!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

207320.description:
Dive into some deep cuts from the world of D-Genesis! Originally included as limited-time bonus features for the Japanese volume releases, these short stories have finally been put together into an anthology and made available for all readers to enjoy. From familiar characters experiencing spooky summer vacations or curry-tastic culinary journeys, to “what-if” stories exploring alternate realities, to the inner monologues of cats and slimes, this collection has a little bit of everything! You’ll also find copious behind-the-scenes commentary from the author about each volume’s story. So strap in and get your D-Cards ready—there’s plenty of exploring to be done!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

207322.description:
To Hae-Jin, the stranger with black eyes, ‘family’ was the warmth he wanted to protect with his entire life. But instead of the blessings of his 20th birthday, a cruel tragedy arrived. To save his shattered family, Hae-Jin offers himself as a commodity. His partner was Ryle, a cold-blooded tycoon and extreme alpha. To Ryle, Hae-Jin was merely a disposable commodity to relieve his pheromone congestion. Despite being a dominant alpha, Ryle despised omegas intensely. Hae-Jin was treated like a tool, his body and mind crumbling further amidst the humiliation and abuse from servants who ignored their master's neglect. As days piled up, each one barely bearable, news of his parents' death, his sole support arrived. Hae-Jin left behind the life of nothing but suffering in the mansion. It was only after that Hae-Jin departed that something strange began to happen to Ryle, who had thought of him as just another easily acquired omega.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

207323.description:
Webtoon artist Seol U-Young decided to try his hand at BL after seeing positive reactions on social media. To gather proper research material, U-Young heads to a gay bar, where he runs into Jun-Hyuk. Though he genuinely wanted to help Jun-Hyuk, who was asking for assistance in a tough spot, Jun-Hyuk mercilessly tramples on U-Young's kind intentions.

'How could I have been charmed by such trash!'

Feeling pathetic, U-Young ends up having the worst day ever. Then one day, U-Young receives notice that his assigned PD is changing. A few days later, at the meeting that follows, he finds himself face to face again with Jun-Hyuk, that piece of trash not even fit for recycling.

“PD-nim?! I'm having a hard time...”

“I'm still lacking. We need mutual satisfaction for a symbiotic relationship. Right, Writer?”

But how did we end up in this kind of relationship?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

207326.description:
Cold-blooded, solitary, personality disordered, chaebol... and obsessive, the epitome of an obsessive maniac Ji Tae-Gwang. That very man suddenly becomes the butler to a cat that appeared out of nowhere?! Are you really the Ji Tae-Gwang I knew...?

The chaotic daily life story of an obsessive maniac who falls from grace to become a butler.

207330.description:
Rain Garland, an enchantment mage belonging to the ‘Fangs of the Royal Beast’, one of the continent's five great guilds, was suddenly expelled from the guild one day. Filled with bitter disappointment at being betrayed by those he trusted, Rain retrieved all the Enhancement Points he had placed on the guild's armor. He then tried applying them to his own sword and clothes instead the cheap copper sword gained destructive power rivaling legendary blades, and the simple cloth garments gained defense comparable to orichalcum!? Moreover, Rain's enchantment magic held a cheat-level secret that allowed it to evolve even further!?

After meeting new companions like the renowned beautiful knight Lily, who came upon hearing rumors of Rain, and the noble lady Martina, a candidate for the title of Hero, Rain begins to grow into a great adventurer...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Arnoyk, the legendary hero known as the strongest swordsman in history, passed down through generations. By some twist of fate, he was reincarnated as Annette, a beautiful maid who captivates everyone's gaze. Having spent her past life consumed by battle, Annette now wishes to live peacefully in this life as a maid in the count's household, avoiding the path of the sword. However, an incident occurs when Rosalena, the count's daughter, goes missing—!? Faced with overwhelming obstacles, Annette unleashes her ultimate sword skills to protect those dear to her!!

The former Sword Saint, hiding her true power while living as a maid, rarely unleashes her might and runs rampant with her broom in hand. The isekai fantasy begins!

207341.description: Note: Originally self-published on Twitter and Pixiv, was then licensed by Kadokawa for commercial release.

207342.description:
I decided to destroy my boyfriend.

High school student Kitabayashi Shou had a problem. Since childhood, he has had a sudden "destructive urge" that makes him want to destroy something inside him. Terrified of this, and knowing that he will ruin his life if he continues like this, Shou decides to fulfill this desire just once. One day, he happens to walk into an old stationery store in town. He meets the older, gentle-mannered owner, Sasai Keijirou, and makes a decision.

"I'll go with this guy."

(Source: Printemps Shuppan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

207345.description:
Konatsu is a magazine editor. Her first sex ended in failure, which discouraged her so much she's still a virgin despite being nearly 30. One day, during a photoshoot, a handsome model greets her with the words, "it's been a while." He turns out to be her ex-boyfriend Yuu who's been the source of her trauma! Saying that he's taken up the job wanting to meet her, he presses her against the bed and starts kissing and caressing her gently. Her private part is all wet and tingly as he pushes his hard XL against her. When Yuu comes deep inside her, Konatsu feels so good her body bends in pleasure...!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: HITTING THE DEEPEST PART OF ME WITH AN XL... I Can't Escape from the Revenge SEX!
title.native: XLで奥までトントンされて…リベンジHから抜け出せない！
title.romaji: XL de Oku made Tontonsarete Revenge H kara Nukedasenai!

207346.description:
The Demon King Krad, is a threat to the Dominion Continent. Dreaming of a decisive battle with a worthy rival, he sits in the Demon King's castle, waiting patiently for warriors. Fatigued by thousands of years of waiting for a worthy opponent, Krad stumbles upon human poo culture. But what genre is the favorite of this absolute being, possessing the power to destroy the world...?

(Source: Naver, translated)

207348.description:
Notes:
- Originally serialized under the title "Soredemo, Koi wo Suru (それでも、恋をする)".
- Includes two extra chapters.

207349.description:
Ten years after a brutal alien invasion, humans have evolved mutant abilities to survive. While the world fights on the frontlines, Kaihas chooses a path of shame. Labeled a coward for refusing to serve, he stays in the shadows to cultivate a secret power. Drawing on memories from a past life, he masters five primary talent trees rooted in his soul. As the war reaches a breaking point, Kaihas quietly upgrades his skills to face the nightmarish alien monsters. Will the boy they once ridiculed become the savior they never expected?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: The Ten Thousand Clans Invasion: Guardian of the Rear
Invasion of All Races: All the People Join the War, I Stay Behind
覚醒した回帰者の復讐

title.english: I Subjugate Myriad Supreme Class

207352.description:
"Wait... That's way too big, it won't fit...!"

Yua Tachibana is a single office worker in her late twenties, feeling the pressure as her friends begin to get married. Still a virgin, she dreams of meeting the kind of sweet, gentle, and cute boy you'd find in a girls' comic. Unfortunately, her daily reality is full of men who are nothing like her ideal-especially her boss, who's blunt and tactless. One night, as she drinks alone at a bar, she meets a drunk, adorable young man who looks exactly like her type. To her shock, he confesses that he fell in love with her at first sight. Flattered and caught up in the moment, Yua agrees to go to a hotel with him. What happens next is nothing like the innocent fantasy she imagined. Despite his cute face, he teases and ravishes her body with relentless intensity-taking her virginity and leaving her trembling, breathless, and utterly satisfied. Again and again, his insatiable desire overwhelms her. Yua feels like she's in a dream... until reality hits. Just who is this passionate stranger?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: This Beautiful Boy Was a Beast
title.native: この美少年、猛獣でした

207353.description:
Sakurano Shuuichirou was an honor student who everyone relied on, and had been doing great at his company since his first year there. However, he made a big mistake and decided to resign... With his savings all gone, Shuuichirou was in despair and reached out to eat a weed on the side of the road, but instead, Himawari, a high school girl who makes a living by streaming videos, appeared before him. Just when he thought he could stop her, for some reason she recommended a different weed to him!

As they go on "explorations" looking for food in weeds and nearby rivers, the two gradually become attracted to each other.

A pure love comedy about an age gap, featuring a super popular biology YouTuber!

(Source: Comic Pash! Neo, translated)

title.native: 今宵も俺は女子高生と雑草（晩餐）を探す
title.romaji: Koyoi mo Ore wa Joshikousei to Zassou (Bansan) wo Sagasu

207355.description:
An overwhelming talent can dominate its owner's life. U-Hyuk possessed a powerful physique and violent tendencies, yet lived suppressing them. When U-Hyuk happened to visit Club Peach, he caught the eye of Yu-Bin, the club's manager. Recognizing U-Hyuk's talent, Yu-Bin offered him a chance to follow her. Captivated by Yu-Bin, U-Hyuk accepted. U-Hyuk stepped into the underworld. What awaited him, glory or ruin?

(Source: Naver, translated)

207356.description:
All he wanted to do was play a game. But when the trashy dating sim froze up, a mix of liquid courage and pure frustration took over—and he slammed his laptop shut. Never did he expect to find himself sucked straight into the game itself. Fine, whatever. He'll just speedrun his way out by picking the absolute worst choices. Except...the system has other plans. No matter what he does, the characters keep falling for him. But more importantly, why is he looped back to the starting point? What kind of broken, trash game is this?!

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Love Simulator, Love Stimulator

207357.description:
Ju Sung-Hyeon has it all: the looks, the grades, and a flawless reputation. But his fast track to a golden future hits a massive speed bump when his family drags him to a middle-of-nowhere village. The uniforms are tacky, the locals are worse, and to top it all off, someone else is sitting in his throne as the school’s top student! Enter Park Chan-Woo, a born-and-bred country boy who doesn’t care about Sung-Hyeon’s city prestige. But when Sung-Hyeon confronts his new rival to reclaim his pride, Chan-Woo offers a deal he never expected: "If you want to talk, help me with the harvest first."

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Rural Rivalry

207358.description:
Once a promising athlete, Yoon-Bin is ready to give up after repeated injuries shatter his dreams. At his lowest point, a mysterious man with a tiger tattoo gives him the strength to stand again. Years later, after retiring as a gold medalist and becoming a taekwondo instructor, Yoon-Bin unexpectedly reunites with Kwon Young, an underworld boss and the man who saved his life. Haunted by his past, Young pushes Yoon-Bin away, convinced he brings only harm. But Yoon-Bin refuses to let go, because now it is his turn to become Young’s light.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.
synonyms: สปอตไลต์ส่องใจเธอ

title.english: The Light I Give You

207359.description:
Haruo is a high schooler from Biei, Hokkaido. When he was younger, expressing his emotions wasn't easy, but one day metal set him free. Since then, he's been honing his skills day in and day out, but now it's for him to decide on his next stage in life…?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.english: West Tokyo Metal Bros
title.native: ニシトーキョーメタルブラザーズ

title.romaji: Ima 6-gatsu no Kusaki no Naka no

207369.description:
"This time, I'll take my life into my own hands."

Maricia, the daughter of a marquis, is shunned by her family because she can't use magic. Her fiancé, Heinrich, was her sole source of support, but she discovers he's having an affair with her stepsister, Cannolina! The shock causes her memories of her previous life in another world as "The Shrouded Black Saintess" to resurface. Manipulated and discarded in this and her previous world, she tries to run away to a life for herself. However, Theodore, a mysterious, handsome man, suddenly appears before her. In dire straights, Maricia can't help but reach out and save him... What will happen to Maricia, who wants to live her life alone in peace, and Theodore, the man who wants to have her under a contractual engagement?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: I Want to Live on My Own in This World. Alas...
title.native: 今世では、ひとりで生きようと思います。そのはずが…
title.romaji: Konse de wa, Hitori de Ikiyou to Omoimasu. Sono Hazu ga...

207370.description:
Kanae, an ordinary Japanese office worker, was reincarnated into another world. Thanks to her memories from her past life and her familiarity with fairy tales, she realizes that she's now living as Cinderella! All she has to do now is wait for her fairy godmother to come and free her from her life of toil so that she can meet her prince.

Finally, on the day of the royal ball, just as she's doing laundry and contemplating when her fairy godmother will arrive, someone comes crashing down from the sky. To Kanae's surprise, this mystery person is none other than her fairy godmother... and her ex-boyfriend from her previous life!

Unfortunately, though Kanae remembers breaking up with him due to his rude and prickly nature, she doesn't recall how she died. She can only assume that her former self never got her happy ending.

What was the cause of her death in her previous life? Will she be able to find happiness as Cinderella in this life? What will become of Kanae and her ex?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Time My Fairy Godmother Turned Out To Be My Ex-Boyfriend
title.native: 私を変身させてくれるはずの魔法使いが元カレだった件。
title.romaji: Watashi wo Henshin Sasetekureru Hazu no Mahoutsukai ga Mottokare datta Ken.

207371.description:
Choi Sung-Hyun looks like the perfect catch, handsome, brilliant, and effortlessly privileged. In truth, he’s barely getting by, clinging to a carefully crafted illusion funded by the wealthy men he dates. That fragile life begins to unravel when Kang Joon reenters the picture. Unable to accept being forgotten, Joon’s fixation turns dark. His presence closes in, his control deepens, and before long, Sung-Hyun finds himself trapped in an obsession he can’t escape.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Mine

207372.description:
When a moment of impulsive violence leaves Victor with a corpse on his hands, he expects his life to end. Instead, he meets Nathan, a man who seems to have been waiting for this exact moment. Nathan promises total immunity in exchange for one simple wish: Victor’s heart and body. Trapped in a contract with a man who is clearly not right in the head, Victor realizes that being rescued might just be the most painful thing that’s ever happened to him.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Digging

207373.description:
A spoiled nobleman, a vengeful servant, and a house lost in the fog. Sang-Ro thought money could buy him anything, but it can’t buy his way out of this nightmare. After falling from a cliff, he is "rescued" by Du-Gyeon, the servant he spent years abusing. Now, with no one to hear his cries, Sang-Ro must face a terrifying truth: Du-Gyeon has been nursing a dark obsession since they were children. The master has become the plaything, and the servant is finally ready to collect his dues.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: When the Cuckoo Cries in the Mist

title.english: Echoes In The Mist

207374.description:
Da-In reluctantly goes on a blind date in her friend’s place with Do-Young, a man notorious for being rude to his dates. The night unexpectedly ends in a one-night stand, and Da-In runs away—but Do-Young quickly realizes she lied about who she was. His offer—date him for 3 months. What will Da-In do?

(Source: Manta)

207375.description:
Ji-Tae finds himself in crisis because of Tae-Heon, who succeeded in a massive gang bust operation. After all his collection agents and even his sex partners were arrested by prosecutors, the lone Ji-Tae, consumed by vengeance, sends Tae-Heon countless letters containing sexual harassment to torment him. Finally, with his work disrupted, Tae-Heon, filled with rage, checks the sender of the letters... The sender is his high school classmate, Lee Ji-Tae?!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: The third story in Lezhin's Jungnyeon Danpyeonseon (중년 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: Midlife Crisis: Can We Be Friends?

207377.description:
Heo Jae-Hyuk, who barely managed to return to school after enlisting to evade punishment for messing with a taken man. This semester, he tries to get his act together and focus on his studies, but old habits die hard—he finds himself on the brink of expulsion. However, Jae-Hyuk uses his quick wit to approach Professor Seong-Ho, who has unsavory rumors circulating within the department, and proposes a deal....!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: The fourth and final story in Lezhin's Jungnyeon Danpyeonseon (중년 단편선) Collection.

207378.description:
Jin, who had been regularly sending letters to an orphanage, suddenly realizes through Michael's unexpected visit that his letters had been misdelivered all along. After reading Jin's letters, Michael becomes curious about him. Attracted by Jin's appearance, he seduces him and they spend the night together. Michael wanted to see him again, but Jin refused, and ultimately, they parted ways after that one night. However, Jin, who kept thinking about Michael, eventually went back to find him...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: The second story in Lezhin's Jungnyeon Danpyeonseon (중년 단편선) Collection.

207379.description:
By day, Jin Ho-Rang works as a janitor. By night, he picks up extra shifts at a club, scraping by while doing his best to stay cheerful. So when he suddenly receives a marriage proposal from the parent of his high school crush, Cha Ah-Jo, he can hardly believe it. Back then, Ah-jo was a beautiful omega who seemed to shine like a flower. Ho-Rang is told that Ah-Jo’s health declined after a single reckless night the two once shared, and that this is why the family is pushing for the marriage. Expecting a fragile and delicate figure from his memories, Ho-Rang goes to meet him again. Instead, he finds a towering, wildly different man who barely resembles the gentle Ah-Jo he once knew. Caught between nostalgia, shock, and an unexpected new dynamic, Ho-Rang is pulled into a whirlwind engagement that is nothing like what he imagined, turning his quiet life into a chaotic and heartfelt romantic comedy.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: นายแก้มแดงของคุณอัลฟ่า

title.english: When Life Gives You Tomatoes

207380.description:
Look at how these bounty hunters riffraff live their lives in Ash Town!

Note: Winner of the 18th New World Manga Award and Honorable Mention and Supernova Award.

207381.description:
The world unfolded in my dream, It was the late Goguryeo period, And I became Yeon Nam-Saeng, son of Yeon Gaesomun. In reality, I am Kim Nam-Saeng...

(Source: Naver, translated)

207382.description:
The unholy love story of the personal secretary who dreamed of a master-servant relationship built on unbreakable ‘trust’ and the Demon Prince who desired only ‘love’.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

207383.description:
Rookie cop and a genius thief - two outcasts from opposite worlds are forced to team up to catch the criminal mastermind.

One’s a hot-headed rookie shunned by her precinct. The other’s a brilliant thief ostracized by her peers. Thrown together against their will, they soon realize… The person they’re chasing might not be as dangerous as the reflection staring back at them.

When the long arm of justice meets a shapeshifting trickster, this mission starts to spiral into something no one expected…

title.native: 幼馴染サキュバスの限界求愛搾精
title.romaji: Osananajimi Succubus no Genkai Kyuuai Sakusei

title.native: 10年ぶりに会ったチビが甘えん坊のまま引きこもりムッチリデカ女になっていた
title.romaji: 10-nen Buri ni Atta Chibi ga Amaenbou no Mama Hikikomori Mucchiri Deka Onna ni Natteita

title.native: せんぱい大好きウザイ系後輩とどろどろエッチしまくる本
title.romaji: Senpai Daisuki Uzai-kei Kouhai to Dorodoro Ecchi Shimakuru Hon

title.native: 母のサンゴオッパイに魅せられて
title.romaji: Haha no Sango Oppai ni Miserarete

title.native: 俺も宮田のお母さん好きだったのに!
title.romaji: Ore mo Miyata no Okaa-san Suki Datta no ni!

207393.description: One-shot published in Kawade Shobo's Daisuke Igarashi special issue Igarashi Daisuke: Sekai no Sugata wo Kanjiru Mama ni.
synonyms: 五十嵐大介: 世界の姿を感じるままに
Igarashi Daisuke: Sekai no Sugata wo Kanjiru Mama ni

207394.description: Advertisement for an English course that ran on the back of several Shoujo magazines in the 80s.

207395.description:
It's another beautiful sunny day in the tropical island of Astania. The Host's day begins with buying supplies at the market. White sheets and a blue sky. He serves his guests his signature dishes. He is also often visited by unusual guests. The list goes on and on, from a sleep-deprived civil servant, to his sister's friend searching for herself, to a mother struggling with her relationship with her daughter. Acquapazza with chili peppers, carrot risotto, fried saimin with a fried egg. Welcome to the Host's daily life, where filling your stomach may or may not solve all your problems!

(Source: TO Books, translated)

title.native: 穏やか貴族の休暇のすすめ。@COMIC ～宿主の毎日メシ～
title.romaji: Odayaka Kizoku no Kyuuka no Susume. @COMIC: Shukushu no Mainichi Meshi

title.native: 穏やか貴族の休暇のすすめ。短編集
title.romaji: Odayaka Kizoku no Kyuuka no Susume. Tanpenshuu

207397.description:
As descendants of a divine flower, women of the Sacred Bloom tribe have the power to heal all wounds as well as release an irresistible scent that renders all men lovestruck. Ari is the last surviving member of her tribe, but she has yet to learn how to control her mysterious powers. When Prince Dokyeom learns of this, he vows to protect Ari and eventually make her his bride and empress of Dowol. But as Ari's powers awaken, can she keep other men at bay long enough for her to become empress?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 君の花びらが舞い香る
กลัดกลีบบุปผา

title.english: Flowerstruck

207398.description: Angie is a boy from a well-to-do family who has just lost his parents. Refusing his greedy relatives, he decides to pay a visit to his uncle Hubert in California. However, an incident occurs on his first night at his uncle's mansion, and from that point onward, Angie begins to become suspicious of his uncle...

title.native: ヒューバートおじさんの優しい愛情

207399.description:
Mayuri, twenty-six-year-old, is a sales worker at one of the leading advertisement companies in Japan. She is beautiful, sociable, and clever. However, there is something she is troubled by...her stalker. This someone follows her no matter how many times she moves.

One night, she spots a suspicious man fumbling in her trash. She realizes that he is Ryo, her classmate from high school. He must be the stalker! Mayuri, feeling pure rage, suddenly comes up with a plan...let him think she is in love with him, then dump him!

A love story full of suspense!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: One Night I Threatened My Stalker and Made Him My Boyfriend
title.native: ある夜、ストーカーを脅迫して彼氏にしました。
title.romaji: Aru Yoru, Stalker wo Kyouhaku shite Kareshi ni shimashita.

207400.description:
Chihiro, twenty-five-old, is madly in love with her colleague, Nakaba. He's cool, clever and handsome. They go for a drink almost every day, so she knows that he likes her too. However, she can't ask him to go out with her, since part of her thinks she's happy the way they are. One day, her good friend tells her that she should tell Nakaba right away that she loves him, or else he'll be some other girl's boyfriend. Chihiro decides to tell him, but she's got a big project to handle in front of her... Can they become lovers?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Antsy for Love ~Waiting for a Budding Romance to Bloom~
title.native: じれ恋、はじめました。 ～君と私で、恋になるまで～
title.romaji: Jirekoi, Hajimemashita. Kimi to Watashi de, Koi ni Naru made

207401.description:
Jae-Jung, the head instructor at a jiu-jitsu gym, is constantly frustrated by his troublesome member, Yeon-Woo. While maintaining a relationship that couldn't get any closer, an unexpected accident leads Jae-Jung to witness Yeon-Woo using adult toys. Yeon-Woo then blackmails Jae-Jung, using his membership as leverage, demanding help with his adult toy usage...

Refund... May I assist you, member?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

207402.description:
Olivia Bell Ervine, daughter of a Marquess was poisoned after she was accused of killing the Saint. However, she was summoned by the God Demiur and reincarnated with her memory to three years before the poisoning. In her new life, she finds out that the world she is in is similar to the game she played in her beforelife. Also, she is now aware that she has a special "poison skill"!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: I'm a Villainess to be Poisoned, so Why am I Being Adored?
title.native: 毒殺される悪役令嬢ですが、いつの間にか溺愛ルートに入っていたようで
title.romaji: Dokusatsu sareru Akuyaku Reijou desu ga, Itsu no Manika Dekiai Route ni Haitte Ita you de

207403.description:
Aiko worked hard to get a job at a good company, but in her first year, she meets Seiichi and ends up marrying him. Acceding to his wishes, she quits her job and becomes a housewife. At first, everything is smooth sailing. She enjoys her role supporting the man she loves as he aims for success... But before they've even been married a year, Aiko discovers that Seiichi is having an affair. It starts with small things, like coming home late, but it continues to get more and more flagrant. In spite of what she knows, Aiko still holds out a tiny hope for the husband that she loves, and resolves to continue with this imperfect but tranquil lifestyle. That is, until she discovers an even more shocking truth...!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Camouflage Marriage

207404.description:
Kang Yi-Seo, who always lived under discrimination because he was a Beta, was forced to take a suspicious drug by a classmate who hated him during him school days. Due to the drug's aftereffects, he now needs an Alpha's pheromones. Then, an old acquaintance appears before Yi-Seo after years apart. Jeong Do-Eun, an Alpha, steps forward, declaring he will help Yi-Seo...

“I'd rather die than sleep with you.”

What awaits these two, consumed by twisted affection and hatred...?!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

title.native: 攻略対象じゃありません！

207406.description:
While grinding through another exhausting night of overtime, Yoon Se-hyeon spots a mindless "Would You Rather" game online: "Work at your company for 30 years to get 1 billion won, OR let an alien watch you for 7 days to get 100 million won." Without thinking much of it, he picks the latter option...only for a real, live alien to pop up right in front of him. Now, Se-hyeon is officially stuck being alien's test subject for the next week. While he prepares for the worst, he realizes one critical detail: this alien is drop-dead gorgeous. Will Se-hyeon actually be able to make it back to his normal life after seven days?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: 7 Days Under Alien Watch

207407.description: To investigate the truth behind his sister's sudden disappearance, a rookie Enforcer arrives at the special zone city of Laia, where unlawfulness runs amok. But when he bumps into a mysterious amnesiac with an unknown identity, he is forced to cohabitate with him. Numerous strange signs hint that his identity might be more than what he had imagined, and he soon discovers that the monsters depicted in myths may not be myths after all...

207408.description:
Nika is a second-year high school student who moved from Tokyo to the Kansai region. She is the type of person who is comfortable being alone, and she had hoped to spend her time peacefully at her new school without getting too involved with anyone. However, on her first day at the new school, she meets Takanashi Yura, the son of a gangster who wants to make friends but doesn't have any.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 訳アリ小鳥遊くんと××したい

207409.description:
It's spring. 30-year-old Kana witnesses her boyfriend, whom she was thinking of marrying, cheating on her with a junior colleague at work. She decides that she "doesn't need a man anymore" and decides to move away, but...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 妹に全てを奪われた元最高聖女は隣国の皇太子に溺愛される
title.romaji: Imouto ni Subete wo Ubawareta Moto Saikou Seijo wa Ringoku no Koutaishi ni Dekiai Sareru

207411.description: Note: Published in 14 parts on konnyaku's PixivFANBOX account.

title.native: 夜光闘姫スカーレット

207416.description: Third title in the Kasumi Den series.

title.native: カオスギア－導かれし少女－

207419.description:
Problem-solver Yu Ha-Rin, who handles anything! After receiving a request to find out why her son refuses to marry, she infiltrates the company as Kim Ha-Yeon to meet the target, Mun Jin-U...

Huh...? This wasn't supposed to be the kind of relationship with the target?! Catchphrase: I've hooked the target!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

207421.description:
Poor Eurydice is cursed to go back a year in time if she dies before turning 20. Although she has died 14 times and woken up again as a 19-year-old woman, all her loved ones have aged normally. That includes her now 34-year-old husband, Orpheus, who thinks he's the only one with memories of Eurydice's past lives. However, Eurydice also remembers every futile attempt to survive. Despite their love for each other, the tragic couple can feel their hearts growing numb with each forboding death. Will Eurydice finally make it to her 20th birthday and break this cycle of pain?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: Eurydice's Coffin

207422.description:
Momose Chieri, a former child prodigy, is now 15 years old. After taking a break from showbiz, she enrolls in Hikarihama High School and joins the dance club where her idol, dancer Sorano Aoha, joins, aiming to reach the pinnacle of dance!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

207423.description:
Plagued by bad luck since childhood, Jiang Yao was struggling to make it alone in the big city. Disaster struck when he was laid off, followed immediately by a mysterious fire in his rental apartment. After draining his life savings to cover the damages, he was left completely penniless. ​Unable to afford rent, Jiang Yao moved into the dilapidated ancestral home left by his late grandfather. While cleaning the crumbling house, he was terrorized and chased by Shen You, a female ghost guarding the property. In his panicked escape, he accidentally flung open the bedroom wardrobe. Suddenly, both he and his spectral pursuer were sucked into a world hidden behind the wardrobe, beginning his "Infinite Flow" adventure.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: Grandpa's Wardrobe and the Ghost I Inherited Unfortunately Inherited Grandpa's Wardrobe and Female Ghost
Unfortunately Inherited Grandpa's Wardrobe and Female Ghost

title.native: 不幸继承爷爷的衣柜和女鬼
title.romaji: Buxing Jicheng Yeye de Yigui He Nü Gui

207424.description:
Under Drive Carpet follows 3 sisters: Ichiko, Juuko, and Yorozuko.
Ichiko is a drunkard college student who's always broke and fighting with Juuko, the middle sister. Juuko on the other hand is more responsible and composed, being the cooler-headed one in the family. Yorozuko is the youngest sister of the bunch and mostly serves as the emotional safe-harbor of the other two.

title.native: アンダードライブカーペット

207425.description: The true identity of the saint that is worshipped by all the people in the kingdom is actually an average boy? With the beautiful priest, the big breasted knight, and the loli doctor at the side, the road of a saintess is really difficult...

title.english: Forced to Be an Invincible Saintess

207426.description:
Kazuki Tsukigase transfers to Saiki Island High School, in search of a fresh start where no one knows him. On Saiki Island, there is a place called “Vanishing Cove,” and in early summer, Kazuki discovers a girl collapsed there. The girl, who regained consciousness at the hospital, says her name is Nanao — 16 years old. But nothing else about her identity is known. What does Nanao mean when she quietly muttered the phrase “1974"?

(Source: Pixiv Comics, translated)

title.native: どこよりも遠い場所にいる君へ
title.romaji: Doko yori mo Tooi Basho ni Iru Kimi e

207427.description:
My friend Isumi was about to get married. As a pre-wedding celebration, we decided to have a house party at my place.

We'd been best friends since school, and since she was so boyish back then, I treated her like a guy friend. But when I saw Isumi again after so long, she still had traces of her old self, yet she'd become feminine and cute.

As the drinks flowed, Isumi finally spoke up.
“You know... I liked you until around XX...”

I couldn't hide my shock at this sudden confession.

“Do I look cute now?”
‘Yeah, you do...’
“Then... can you hold me?”
‘But...’
“Anything but kissing is fine... Anything... It's my way of drawing the line...”

Is this what they mean by “crossing the line”? And after crossing that line, can we still be friends... Settling the lingering feelings from their student days, they move forward. A bittersweet, sensual night for the two former best friends.

(Source: Melonbooks, translated)

Note: Released at Comiket 107.
synonyms: When I Crossed the Line With My Tomboy Friend

207429.description:
After dying three times, Hillia finally learns the truth: she’s stuck in a novel where a cunning woman keeps killing her to take her place. On her last chance, she strikes a deal with the feared crown prince—fated to lose himself to madness. He kidnaps her at her wedding, and in return, she helps him ease his affliction and claim the throne. Now she must navigate both her enemy’s schemes and the prince’s volatile temper. Can she outplay the woman who ended her while surviving the man she chose?

(Source: Tapas)

I'm Going to Change My Husband With a Predatory Marriage
I'll Change My Husband First Through a Marriage of Conquest

207431.description:
In 1940, amidst an era of chaos, a beautiful mansion named Yeongchunhwa was built on a remote island, constructed solely out of a man's deep love for his wife. Time passed, and the story of the couple tied to the mansion faded from memory. Yet one day, a mysterious ‘caretaker’ appeared, transforming it into a lodging establishment. He began inviting people to the mansion—those who must love, guided by the couple's spirits...!

“Welcome to Yeongchunhwa, the secret mansion that will bring you infinite imagination. Here, any form of love is possible. Love and indulge freely. As long as the mansion permits.”

A luxurious mansion and the people who visit it for various reasons. Erotic stories for women, crafted by various authors, unfold now.

Sixth Short Story [Exclusive] Exposing That Scoundrel's Debauchery!: Reporter Jung Na-Hui, sent to Yeongchunhwa on a reward vacation after publishing an unverified article exposing the scandalous private life of rising star Kang Do-Hyuk. But as they say, enemies meet on a narrow bridge. Do-Hyuk, who has fallen from grace due to Na-Hui's article, also arrives at Yeongchunhwa, sent there as a hiding place. The two encounter each other at the mansion. But strangely, Do-Hyuk seems delighted to see Na-Hui? Amidst endless flirting, will Na-Hui be able to uncover his lewd and dissolute(?) true nature!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: Mansion Yeong Chunhwa: [Exclusive] I Report That Delinquent!

207433.description:
I found myself lost in a novel world, possessing an utterly ordinary supporting character. I intended to live quietly, but swept along by events, I ended up marrying the heroine's father. My plan was simple: “Make the daughter happy, then divorce.” That was all it should have been.

But the daughter was adorable, and her husband clumsy yet kind. Smiles gradually filled the once-cold house, and her “divorce plans” began to waver alongside her growing desire to live in this home. Despite misunderstandings from others, family complications, and the original story's “separation route” standing in their way, the three of them slowly reclaim the warmth of family through small daily choices.

(Source: Piccoma, translated)
synonyms: I Love My Family Too Much to Get a Divorce
I Can't Divorce Because I Love My Family
