207434.description:
Shine a light on the hidden truth.

One day, Takumyo, who has the special power to "call back souls," receives a request from Seiryuu, a powerful nobleman. Takumyo decides to cooperate for a "certain purpose" related to his own origins, but Seiryuu also has complicated reasons for his actions...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

207435.description:
After six years of long-distance dating, the Ho-Rong & Po-Rong couple finally move in together along with their companion cat, Park Jang-Deok (a.k.a. Jjangdeok)! Under one roof, the cohabitation of three family members begins. Somewhere between lovers and spouses, seemingly just dating yet somehow different.

A lively and real glimpse into the daily life of a cohabiting couple!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

207436.description:
A top-tier security expert who's also sharp as a tack White hacker Baek Dan-Hui. But even she had a problem: On rainy nights, she'd have nightmares and couldn't sleep! Then one day, she accidentally spent the night with Taeju Group's Executive Director Kwon Tae-San, and slept like a baby...? Then, shamelessly, “Executive! I'll just hold your hand and sleep!”

A romantic comedy of healing wounds between a capable man and a capable woman, deeply entangled by one incident.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: Executive, Let's Just Hold Hands and Sleep
Mr. Manager, I'll Just Hold Your Hand and Sleep

207437.description:
A series of cat killings occurs in a neighborhood. The suspect is surprisingly Baek Si-Yun, the top student in his third-year middle school class. When Si-Yun finds himself in a situation where no one believes his claims of innocence, he sets out to find the real cat killer himself, accompanied by his friends Su-Min and Jeong-Hyeon, who believe in him. However, during their search for the killer, they become entangled with Hwa-Ja, an auntie working at an animal shelter, and Detective Jun-Woo, who lurks around Hwa-Ja, plunging them into an uncontrollable whirlwind of events...

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

207440.description:
As a young man, Shirokiba left his small island seeking glory as a pro wrestler in Tokyo. After much sacrifice, he returns to his hometown as a champion, but he finds that it's overrun by mysterious aliens! Strike, throw, hold, cheat! He'll need to use everything he's learned from pro wrestling to take down these monsters! Blood, sweat, and aliens getting their butts kicked in this high-octane pro wrestling action series!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

207442.description:
Carried in on a spring breeze, love suddenly flew into Nanaho's life! The moment she sees this guy on her college campus, she's fallen head over heels. Rushing over, she impulsively blurts out her feelings and asks him out. No surprise, she gets a totally flat-out "Uh... Sorry, I can't..." in response!! Nanaho then throws out a desperate request to just be friends instead, not expecting much, only for him to answer with a "Sure. That'd be great!" Well, now what...?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: 欲情されると困ります。

207443.description:
Nachi never expected her teenage sweetheart Haru to come walking back into her life, much less moving next door and working at the same office! She swore she'd never love again, but being with him makes old feelings resurface...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Coming Together

207444.description:
Niko Usui is still an outcast even though it’s been a month into her second year of high school. She tries to make friends, but nothing seems to work. One day, when she volunteers to cover for a classmate, she gets paired up with Minato. Spending time with the cheerful, outgoing boy, her exact opposite, was incredibly awkward at first. Thinking she’d rather just work by herself, Hitomi blurts out, “I’m a total masochist, so I’m fine! Leave me alone!” But then Minato said, “Here’s an order from me. Since you’re a masochist, you’ll obey, right?” And then…!?

(Source: Betsufure, translated)

207446.description:
Elise, a princess of a small kingdom, Loubeshran, was known all over the continent for her cleverness and beauty. But she had a malicious tongue. Her father, the king, said to her countless times-"Oh Elise, no one is asking for your hand in marriage..." She didn't care what her father says. She just cares for peace and prosperity of her kingdom. Then one day, Klaus, a prince of a large empire, comes to see her. "I love you from the bottom of my heart, princess...." The prince says. This is a twisted love story about a princess with a twisted tongue and a wicked(?) prince!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

207448.description:
Lexion, the leader of the Villain Alliance, and Yu Sena, the Hero of Korea, are now husband and wife. It was a global sensation: the Hero who reformed the villain through love and dismantled his alliance. But no one knows the truth. Not even his wife, the former hero herself, knows the true nature of Lexion’s power.

“If she’s pinned under me, getting fucked by my cock... would she cry like that, too?”

(Source: Manta)

Note: Part of Metatoon's Gyeryak Danpyeonseon (계략 단편선) Collection.

207450.description:
Sayo, born to a rural village, lost her mother and now everyone sees her as a nuisance. When a drought strikes the village, the chief decides to drown her in a lake as a sacrifice to the water god "Suijin-sama." She thought her life ended there...but she wakes up with fluffy animals all around her! Bear, wolf, monkey, fox...and a penguin! Then the bear tells her: "You, a human, and you, a funny looking creature in black-and-white. Did you trespass, knowing that this is Suijin-sama's inner court?" What is this place!? Sayo had no idea what is awaiting her. A heart-warming fantasy with lots of cute fluffy animals everywhere!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

207452.description:
The daughter to a family that owns a development company, Ruka Kosaka, is reunited with her childhood friend, Mikage Mizuki, after 13 years... for an arranged marriage. The two know they are getting into a loveless marriage, but if just something can help start their relationship off on the right foot... or so Ruka thought, but Mizuki seems to be distant and uninterested in anything. Looks like it's not worth getting hopes up. However, the first chance Ruka gets to look deeply into Mizuki's eyes, it seems like there's far more feeling, passion even, than what she's been led to believe.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Mio is a beautiful young woman who is highly regarded within the company for her work ethic. She has been popular with men since her student days, and as an excuse to turn down confessions from the opposite sex, she asks her childhood friend Naozumi to pretend to be her boyfriend. The two continued their fake relationship so that no one would find out, and before they knew it, 10 years had passed...

When Mio decides she can't tie him down any longer and brings up the idea of ​​breaking up, Naozumi, who she had always thought of as a younger brother, shows a surprising side of himself...

A pure love story between a shy career woman and a devoted younger man, as 10 years of love comes to life!

After a decade stuck as an E-Class hunter, Hara is suddenly hit with an S-Class Awakening Quest: date the nation’s beloved news anchor, Seheon. What starts as a desperate deal for “Official S-Class Mission Assistance” quickly turns into a strange, unpredictable romance.

Ju-Han Seo, the genius partner at Yulyoung Law, is an absolute nutjob. After a single, drunken mistake where she may or may not have jumped him, Arin thought she could just go back to her life. That is, until Juhan says to her over coffee: "I'm impotent, Attorney Jung. And it's all your fault."

The sacred maiden of the Kazami clan, a family of renowned onmyoji, can wield immense power so long as she maintains her purity. But when her childhood friend, Kyousuke, tags along on her missions...!

Ally is a boy who uses his small physique to become a cross-dressing assassin. His only joy is going to a nearby hamburger restaurant, but he witnesses some nasty men getting involved with Cynthia, who runs the restaurant. What action will Ally take to save Cynthia?

Hundreds of years have passed since mankind ventured out into space, yet any evidence of other life remains elusive. For what reason do we live in this vast, lonely universe? From Kuu Tanaka, creator of the ongoing hit series "Maison and the Man-Eating Apartment," comes the long-awaited latest sci-fi one-shot!

The student council president candidate’s shocking speech leads to his inevitable defeat. Though his fellow class representative Mayuri tries to cover for him, it seems he may be hiding a divine secret...?!

Wizards possess powers beyond human comprehension. Inquisitors are tasked with cracking down on these selfish wizards. While investigating a certain wizard, Nox, an inquisitor, somehow ends up teaming up with Casey, the "Witch of Death"...

On their way to school, Nori, a high school girl, notices a moth stuck to her friend Hiro’s head. Oblivious to her own predicament, Hiro goes on and on about the importance of proper grooming…

To the public, she is the Knight Commander: a shining symbol of national pride and an idol to the people. In reality? She’s just a glorified middle manager, crushed under a mountain of paperwork and exploited by her relentless superiors.

One day, a man who longed for a close-knit family was reincarnated in the Iscallion Empire, a land of advanced magic. His name was Asha. The unfortunate first prince was unable to become the eldest son due to his lineage, and was destined to be shunned by his beloved younger brothers. So he decided to give up the throne to his second son and enjoy the freedom of pursuing his alchemy hobby. While spending his days immersed in experiments... his overflowing talent and scientific knowledge suddenly led to a great invention!? He also accidentally defeated a prominent nobleman and even came to dominate (?) the battle for the throne. "I'd like to be called Big Brother someday," says the laid-back older brother, who unconsciously takes control of the empire for his younger brother in this heartwarming brothers' fantasy!

Lil, who was reincarnated into a refugee settlement, was hungry again today.
What's more, because her parents don't work, she's been left out and is on the verge of being banished!?
In order to protect her place in the community, she works hard every day to gain the trust of the residents.
Little by little, the little girl's hard work is recognized by those around her. She is determined to one day eat her fill of hot meals, but then she finds out that even refugees can live in town if they become B-rank adventurers...?
Her goal is to escape the refugee crisis! Will you fall in love with this hardworking reincarnated girl?! A laid-back fantasy adventure in another world!

Masaki's been holding on to memories of his first girlfriend, Kotone, since the day she suddenly disappeared. Even with those memories though he's moved on, started dating Nanami, and made plenty of friends. You could say he's living a healthy college student life. Eight years later, he emerges from the Abyss, with a Female Emperor in his left hand and divine demons in his right. Wherever he goes, destruction follows; wherever he treads, fear spreads. Three years ago, the Supreme Bone was stolen, and Jiang Yu fell to the status of a lowly disciple, spending his days chopping firewood and fetching water, enduring constant scorn. Subsequently, the Song and Jin Dynasties joined forces to destroy the Liao Dynasty, reclaiming part of the territory of the Sixteen Prefectures of Yan Yun. Yet while the Song court and people reveled in the joy of reclaiming their ancestral lands, the Jins were already eyeing the Song with predatory intent. Taoist priest Jiang Feixiong, following his master's orders, descended from Mount Kunlun to the capital. Emperor Huizong commanded him to head the “Bureau of Deified Spirits,” bestowing upon him the title “Golden Gate Immortal.”

(Source: Tencent, translated)

207507.description:
The red monster (a great demon) sealed for eight hundred years regained its freedom, intending to dominate the world. Yet it was effortlessly subdued by the cute demon-hunting girl Tang Jie, and the two embarked on a wondrous adventure.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

207508.description:
"In 2019, our city witnessed a serial murder case that claimed seven lives. You were the seventh victim."

In 2019, a major serial murder case occurred in Jielu City, resulting in seven deaths. Years later, Li Yunshan, a survivor of the case, remains haunted by the tragedy. His beloved girlfriend was the seventh victim. By chance, he obtains a phone capable of bridging past and future, and unexpectedly connects with Xu Sixian before her 2019 murder. To prevent the tragedy from repeating and save innocent lives, the two embark on a time-spanning pursuit to track down the killer.

(Source: Shanghai Literature, translated)

C-level Magic Student Who Thinks He Is SSS Class

title.romaji: Jibun wo SSS-kyuu da to Omoi Kondeiru C-kyuu Majutsu Gakusei

207510.description:
Doh Hyeonwoo is an elite "hound" deployed deep into the criminal underworld to dismantle the Black Cloud Tribe, a ruthless syndicate tearing the city's order apart. While his infiltration goes smoothly at first, his mission hits a bizarre roadblock in the form of a man known simply as Mr. Ha. For some reason, this erratic superior interferes with Hyeonwoo’s every move, constantly disrupting the operation. Desperate to maintain his cover, Hyeonwoo defends himself:

"I told you, I’m just a Beta!"

But Mr. Ha merely leans in close, a dangerous smirk on his lips.

"That’s strange. Then why do you smell so incredibly sweet?"

With Mr. Ha ruthlessly invading his personal space and hunting for his hidden scent, Hyeonwoo's vital undercover operation begins to unravel in the most chaotic, intoxicating way possible.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: MBB (My Bad Boss)

207511.description:
Yu-Jin was once a top student with dreams of becoming a doctor until her first love, the rebellious Jun-Ha, turned her carefully planned life upside down. After blaming him for losing her shot at medical school, she vows never to see him again. Years later, they're reunited in a college study group as she prepares for one final chance to achieve her dream. Determined to make amends, Jun-Ha refuses to leave her side, forcing Yu-Jin to confront the boy she once loved and the man he's become. As old feelings resurface, she must decide if love deserves a second chance.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: A Punk, Devoted to Pure Love

title.english: This Punk Wants Love

207512.description:
“What?? You think I like you?? Wh-where did this all go wrong??”

The start of her first heart-pounding solo living experience, and the first day of the new semester—she ran into that bully-like guy, Kim Jun. After narrowly escaping a crisis where she almost got killed(?) by Kim Jun, who mistakenly thought she was following him, Yeon-Hui desperately prayed she'd never have to face that bully again. But then, the bully Kim Jun appeared again in the same apartment building, right next door. Same school, same club too! My head hurts because of this guy next door who acts like he wants to kill me. But then, out of nowhere, that bully Kim Jun suddenly changes and starts getting close to Yeon-Hui...?!

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: The Man Next Door Who Kills Me

207514.description:
"Did you want to exchange husbands?" One husband is all about the bedroom, where the other just wants to sleep. What would happen if these two women began living with the other's husband...?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

“Let's make a deal!”

Ji-An, CEO of a perfume company, has lived her entire life focused solely on scent. After a car accident, she suffers inexplicable loss of smell, bringing her entire life to a halt. But then, she senses a fragrance only from a man she encounters by chance on the street. Han Do-Yun...?! To find the reason, Ji-An proposes a contract to him.

A fragrant romance that begins with a chance encounter!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Unaware of her apartment's tragic history, Kana finds herself tormented by mysterious sounds that exploit the fractures in her crumbling marriage and her struggles with motherhood...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

synonyms: A Farewell to Your First Love

207535.description:
“I love sex. It’s simple and easy to understand.”

Hana and Maki are two friends who make a living by having sex with complete strangers and livestreaming it online. With no home to return to and nowhere they truly belong, their life is still, in its own way, happy. At least, it was… until a certain boy (Hokuto) appeared.

(Source: Funguild, translated)

It looks like we have great sexual chemistry, says my colleague bent on making me his future wife, while fucking me so hard at the office I feel as if I'm going to break...!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.romaji: 29-Sai Jimikyoku no Totsuzen na Moteki: Toshishita Kouhai to Office de Nukazu 3-patsu

207540.description:
In a remote corner of a certain other world, a strong and seasoned female adventurer walks along the frontier…
Noticing a loud disturbance echoing through the area, she discovers a young mage being chased by a monster.
Realizing that the creature attacking him is actually the target of her current quest, she rescues the boy and immediately takes up a battle stance, driving the monster away with ease.

However, puzzled by the fact that it is a type of monster she has never seen in this region, she has no time to react before being ambushed by the very young mage she had just saved, losing consciousness…

When she awakens, she finds herself transported to an unfamiliar place, bound by magic. When she demands an explanation of what has happened, the boy begins to speak with a faint, unsettling smile:
— “You are the one most worthy of being my mate…!”

Will the adventurer be able to escape from this desperate predicament…?!

Note: Released at Comiket 107.

207541.description:
Working at the daycare center of a hospital, Haru lives a normal life, up until the day that she's reunited with Mizuki, her brother's old friend whom she'd admired since childhood. A good-looking, gentle doctor, Mizuki steals the hearts of all the women at the hospital, but for Haru, he'll always be her untouchable chilhood friend that's way out of her league. However, when she finds herself alone with him, Mizuki's sweet words lull her into taking an unexpected step. Little does she know, Mizuki has a secret! Is he really the "Mr. Perfect" she'd always seen him as? Was their reunion really a random coincidence?

A hot and steamy love story about a blissfully unaware girl and a guy whose love might be... a little too much!!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Love Is Just What The Doctor Ordered -His Special Treatments Keep Me Up All Night!-
title.native: 瑞樹くんの愛が重すぎる ～溺愛ドクターのエッチな秘密～
title.romaji: Mizuki-kun no Ai ga Omosugiru: Dekiai Doctor no Ecchi na Himitsu

207542.description:
College students Hina Takamori and Kanata Kamimori grew up next door to each other. Kanata has a perfectly chiseled face, so all the girls swoon over him. However, he's been covering it with a face mask for the past 14 years because Hina suggested it after he became scared of girls always asking him out, ringing his doorbell, or even stalking him. Hina feels guilty over him always wearing them, so she suggests he stops. However, Kanata responds by telling Hina he only wants her...! Kanata reveals his slightly dark but sweet possessive side after taking his face mask off! This is a cute, pure, heart-racing love between two childhood friends and neighbors!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Kanata's Naughty, Doting, and Dark Without His Face Mask On
title.native: マスクを取った奏多くんはえっちで溺愛で、ちょっと黒い。
title.romaji: Mask wo Totta Kanata-kun wa Ecchi de Dekiai de, Chotto Haraguroi.

207543.description:
Shiori Izuki, who at first glance seems like a typical office worker, has a secret. She really loves adult comics for men. She desperately hides this secret, which would ruin her reputation were it to get out. One day, though, her handsome boss, Daiki Nakatori, finds out. Of all people, it would have to be her perfect boss! Shiori despairs, but he shows a surprising amount of understanding. The two then share a drunken moment. However, it seems that Daiki has a secret of his own...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: This Needs To Stay Our Little Secret, Daiki...! -My Handsome Boss Is Also A Huge Hornball!?-
title.native: 暴いちゃダメです、中鳥さん…っ～爽やか上司と変態同人プレイ！？～
title.romaji: Abaicha dame desu, Nakatori-san...: Sawayaka Joushi to Hentai Doujin Play!?

207544.description:
They're alone in the hotel room, and all she can do is ask him to be gentle...
Shiho's trying to make ends meet as an administrative assistant at a hospitality company. Growing up in an adoptive family with a little sister, Mayu, who bullies her to this day, Shiho's hesitant about seeking love or happiness.
Nevertheless, when Mayu forces her to attend a group blind date with a bunch of older men, Shiho meets Yukito, a charming man 12 years her senior. After hitting it off over drinks, they end up spending a passionate night together where Shiho experiences a man's touch for the first time.
The morning after, she's thrown for a loop when Yukito proposes to her out of nowhere. However, that's nothing compared to the shock that awaits her when she finds out what he does for a living!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Who Knew The CEO Was Such A Romantic!? -Proposed To The Morning After Our First Night Of Passionate Love!-
title.native: 年上社長は天然溺愛モンスター～交際0日、処女を摘まれた朝にプロポーズ!?～
title.romaji: Toshiue Shachou wa Tennen Dekiai Monster: Kousai 0-Nichi, Shojo wo Tsumareta Asa ni Propose!?

207545.description:
Ten years ago, the real world and the dungeons of MMORPG games suddenly merged, and "Paradise Heaven" was born here. Dungeons and monsters appeared in various places, and survivors began to be called "players"... Among them, Leo Ameike was taken as a guide to the dangerous special dungeon "Anekmene (Forbidden Zone of Life)". Ameike, an unemployed player, sees an opportunity and tries to escape, but there the party is annihilated by a boss monster of unknown race, ability, and level!

A desperate pinch...! However, his fate begins to change greatly when he encounters the monster...!?

(Source: Piccoma, translated)

まずは親友からよろしくお願いします
やっかいごととやみつきな男と。

207548.description:
Soul Collector No. 157, nicknamed Ikona. As a Grim Reaper, her job is to collect the souls of dead creatures and send them to heaven. But now she has one last request as a Grim Reaper, and it's from an immortal monster...?!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title.native: 死神イコナと不老不死の怪物
title.romaji: Shinigami Ikona to Furoufushi no Kaibutsu

207549.description:
Late-twenties office worker Seiya Tonami has made it a routine to get solo drinks every Friday at his favorite standing bar. But when he rescues a college girl from unwanted harassment at said bar, he gains a new drinking companion. Between everyday banter and light venting, there's now someone by his side to share a laugh with. Cozy up to a heartwarming and slightly tipsy romantic comedy set in a standing bar, where Friday nights become something to look forward to.

(Source: Manga UP!)
synonyms: Gloomy Neighbor at the Standing Bar

title.english: Unwinding with the Aloof Girl at the Standing Bar

Yume to Gen no Hazama de

207551.description:
Her Highness the Princess inexplicably became Empress... Her Highness the Princess inexplicably met her end by the executioner's blade... Her Highness the Princess inexplicably reincarnated back to age six... Her Highness the Princess Lv999... This time, Her Highness the Princess will slaughter all in her path! Who says only heroes can restart their lives?!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: Restarting the Life of the Loser Princess

title.romaji: Suteru Kami Areba Hirou Yankee Ari

207556.description:
In the town of Yadamgoeul, where tales of all manner of monsters, spirits, and human stories are woven, Seol-Ah lives. Following in her father's footsteps as a hunter, she becomes a fearless hunter who races through the mountains. Seol-Ah, hunting the nine-tailed fox that brutally killed her father to avenge his death, awakens after a fall in the home of the dazzlingly beautiful scholar Baek-Ho. She finds herself utterly helpless under Baek-Ho's secretive and gentle touch...

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: The first story in Coconut's Jeonradonghwa Danpyeonseon (전라동화全裸童話 단편선) Collection.

207557.description:
When Bi-Hyun sneaks into the Dragon Palace to rescue her friend, she doesn't expect to get caught—or to end up the dragon king's hostage. Captivity is strangely comfortable. What's far less comfortable is the scandalous prophetic dream she can't shake, starring the man who's keeping her prisoner.

(Source: Manta)

title.english: Spring in the Dragon's Lair

title.native: 知らない君を知っている
お付き合いはしませんけれど。
ちょっとおさえてマリヤ！

207562.description:
Shuna, a rabbit beastwoman, faces an arranged marriage as her species enters heat at adulthood. To get out of it, she proposes to Kirel, a former academy senior, that they spend her first heat together. Little does she know that Kirel is a snake, and mating with a predator may not go exactly as planned.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Part of Haewadal Studio's Saegya Danpyeonseon (색야 단편선) Collection.

title.english: The Rabbit Bride's Mating Survival Guide

ビッグ・ラブ ショルダー

207566.description:
A young girl named Elle makes a deal with the devil and is brought back to life in the body of a woman she had never met... Mika's "late wife." In order to restore her mismatched soul and body, the two search for the devil she made a deal with, but...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

synonyms: My Deceased Husband Came Back to Life

207568.description:
Jack is a friendly butler, but he's not very fond of Chloe, the cold maid. Just when he wonders what to do, he finds himself at the mercy of her unexpected words and actions, and so begins this innocent romantic comedy.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title.romaji: Ki ni Naru Maid ga Iru Hanashi

オレはお前を見てるから
かわいいなんて嘘だと言ってくれ

207573.description:
Ayakashi. Since ancient times, they are monsters born as parasites that prey on the "weakness" of the human heart. Kisaragi, a demon who enjoys feeding on such creatures, is a school nurse and is waiting for an opportunity to infest a student with ayakashi. Tamura Mio is the most beautiful girl in school. She has an obsession with her appearance, and the shadow of ayakashi is approaching her...

Ayakashi can infect your heart too... A dark horror lurking in the modern world!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

207574.description:
Cheryl Olsent is a work of art created by God. Everyone admires her beauty, but her "husband" is none other than the daughter of an aristocrat, Sera Dibras. Because of her beauty, Cheryl has led a life without freedom, using herself as a tool to satisfy someone else's desires. But for some reason, she finds herself drawn to her mysterious companion, Sera, who is infatuated with her and treats her with care.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

207575.description:
Five years since Shinbi left. Ghost vanished without a trace, and peace returned to the world. Ha-Ri, who once fought evil spirits with childhood friends, is now a police officer living a busy life. Then one day, the Ghosts sealed within ‘GAU’ break free, and the dormant disaster stirs once more...!

Right now, Ha-Ri's new journey to save people begins! Right here in ‘Mystery Apartment’.

(Source: Naver, translated)

207576.description:
The story revolves around the menstruation of same-sex couple Yuka and Maria.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

207577.description:
Despite the various demands of her stepmother and stepsisters, Cinderella manages to run her days perfectly with her incredible household skills and insight. She's no mere victim of bullying. She's a "perfect superhuman" who anticipates, plans, and completes everything!

A new interpretation of the Cinderella tale, where wisdom and honesty carve out her own destiny.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.romaji: Tsuka no Ma no Koibito: Senritsu no Midareta Canon

Notes:
- Original serialization ran for 10 chapters. In the volume release, two chapters were combined respectively to make up five chapters.
- Includes three extra chapters.

207588.description:
The sweetest tip to become a Grade 7 civil servant without exams! Get recruited by the National Intelligence Service during military service through recommendation..! So I ended up sitting at home in Dandong, China, the world's powder keg, assigned to monitor the Yalu River Bridge. But starting with that 5 million won night shift, major incidents involving multiple countries kept getting tangled up with me.

Sigh, I just want to make money without working... Huh? But wait, the mission actually got completed luckier than I thought?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

207590.description:
"You will go in place of my daughter to be wed to the Duke of House Dubarry." Leonora has been working tirelessly to ensure her family is fed and out of harm's way. One day, however, she is kidnapped and brought before the notorious Duchess Godot who has one strong demand: pose as her daughter Angennia to be married into the rival house Dubarry, and spy on the Duke for her. Leonora can't refuse, as House Godot now holds her family hostage. Though there are many rumors of the Duke of House Dubarry being a cold and menacing man... Leonora finds herself before a kind and charming gentleman with nothing but warmth! It may be impossible to keep her identity a secret before the wonderfully kind Dinando Dubarry...!!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Imposter Bride: The Manipulated Damsel Is Cherished by the Coldhearted Duke
title.native: 偽りの花嫁～操られた令嬢は冷酷公爵に溺愛される～
title.romaji: Itsuwari no Hanayome - Ayatsurareta Reijou wa Reikoku Koushaku ni Dekiaisareru

207591.description:
Ten years ago, Maribelle suffered a severe chest wound while protecting her young brother-in-law, Leon. However, in aristocratic society, women with physical scars are despised and ridiculed. For this reason, Maribelle left the ducal family she grew up in, but even at a local aristocratic mansion where she worked as a servant, she was called a marred woman and spent her days being mistreated by the countess and the servants. Even now, she is betrayed by the only kind person in her life, and when he attempts to assault her, she is rescued by a heroic knight in black who has stopped by town on his triumphal return. He, whom Maribelle did not recognize, tells her he has come for her.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Marred Lady Is Oblivious to His Excellency's Love!
title.native: 傷物令嬢は義弟の愛に鈍感です!?
title.romaji: Kizumo no Reijou wa Gitei no Ai ni Donkan desu!?

title.romaji: Migawari Byou Bare Reijou no Keiyaku Kekkon nanoni, Kishi Koushaku ga Zettai ni Rikon Shinai to Dekiai shite Kuru

title.native: 富嶽百景グラフィアトル

207596.description: Note: Winner of the 113th New Manga Award Special Encouragement Award.

207597.description:
On a dying Earth, an unforgettable love...

The six-year void of a youth who vanished during his final high school summer and the strange phenomenon that befalls a man and woman visiting a shrine. Three paths, separated by time and place, kindle a small flame of hope within the heart.

An SF omnibus delivering a strange yet warm tale!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: オッドアンドカインド
A Young Lady, On the Brink of Collapse!

title.native: メープルシュガーベイビー

207603.description:
“Shall I write the history of my desires?”

The awakening of sexuality… and its loss… an experience common to all. This is the recollection of desires of a single human being. An autobiographical and experimental work by the literary master Mori Ōgai, now adapted into manga through an overwhelming aesthetic sensibility.

Note: Certain expressions in this work may be considered inappropriate by modern standards. However, in respect for the original text, they have been preserved in their original form wherever possible.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

207604.description:
On Christmas Eve night, college student Masuda met Kurihara, a guy bawling his eyes out at the convenience store where he worked part-time. Even though it was their first time meeting, he got stuck with his whining about being dumped right before Christmas, a real hassle. But when he learned he'd been looking forward to the date, he couldn't just leave him hanging...

"Should I go in place of your girlfriend...?" Before he knew it, he'd offered to be a stand-in, and they ended up going on the date!? The next day, at the meeting spot, stood an intelligent-looking, sparkling Kurihara, a complete stranger compared to the crybaby from yesterdayーー!?

Tearful, handsome puppy-like guy × apathetic but actually kind-hearted guy. A love story where he gets charmed!

(Source: East Press, translated)
synonyms: I Picked Up an Abandoned Boyfriend

title.native: 捨てられ彼氏ひろいました。

207605.description:
The best-looking man in another world...appears! When Rico is summoned to another world by a goddess, she's told her destiny is to marry a prince in order to save the world from destruction!

(Source: MangaPlaza)
synonyms: Unequaled Sadist Magician Ark and My Exclusive Contract

title.native: 絶倫ドS魔術師アークと私の専属契約書
title.romaji: Zetsurin Do S Majutsushi Ark to Watashi no Senzoku Keiyakusho

207606.description:
Genie is a workaholic software developer with serious back pain who's pressured into attending his coworker's birthday party at a gay club. There, he meets a flirty man named Seong-Geun who's famous for "healing" men in the bedroom with his "needle." Thinking Seong-Geun is an actual doctor, Genie follows him to a hotel after some drinks and wakes up naked next to him! Although a one-night stand wasn't in his plans, Genie finds that his back pain is completely gone. And with a major work deadline looming over his head, Seong-Geun's magic touch might be his only salvation.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: Disc Solution

207607.description:
After repeated failures, Ba-Ram was about to give up her dream of becoming a singer when she accidentally got involved in her cousin Han Seok's failing hologram business and became a tester for the hologram mask ‘Echo’. Ba-Ram became the fictional character ‘Min So-Won’ and challenged herself to be a singer once more. Unlike her past failures, she instantly became famous. Ba-Ram must conceal Min So-Won's true identity until the test concludes. However, her friend ‘Gu Re-Um’, who had subscribed to Ba-Ram's YouTube channel for a long time, was actually Kang Ri-Wun, a member of the idol group Sprinter. Meanwhile, Seo Yi-Hyeon, a genius producer and her classmate, suddenly starts showing increasing interest in both Ba-Ram and Min So-Won...!

Can Ba-Ram keep her secret and achieve her goal unscathed?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

207608.description:
“Want to grab a drink?”

Seo Mu-Kyung, heir to the SL Group. Having always lived in the position of a dominant predator, he is arrogant and authoritative. Yet a new desire has found him. A woman he wants to conquer and obsess over has appeared. He wants her completely. Even if it means cutting short her career.

‘This wasn't how I wanted to get close to her...’

Choi Yu-Yeon, SL's youngest employee, has secretly loved Seo Mu-Kyung. Under his instinct-driven dominance, she's always helpless. She couldn't tell him. That she'd liked him for so long. Afraid he'd stop desiring her. But as their relationship deepens, she thinks. This relationship... must end now.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

207611.description:
Medusa, a monster known for her grotesque appearance but who in truth loves children, comes across a child destined to kill her inside a chest that has washed ashore. Determined to avoid her fate of death, she resolves not to kill the child but to raise him instead. She gives him a name and lovingly brings him up. Carefully dodging the potentially fatal crises caused by the child’s every little action, Medusa does her best at childcare. However, a group of humans searching for the child eventually appears before her. Medusa soon realises that they have come to kill him…

Will Medusa be able to escape her destined death and live happily with the child?

A reinterpretation of Medusa—the widely known monster of myth—as a warm, heroic protagonist, along with a newly imagined relationship with her nemesis Perseus. A work intended to be easy to read even for those unfamiliar with the original myth.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

High-spec beauties and semi-cohabiting lovey-dovey (!?) rom-com!

Following his homeroom teacher's advice, Jinpei Itsuki moves to Tokyo and enrolls in high school. He reunites with his childhood friend Kanna, only to discover she's become a genius entrepreneur earning hundreds of millions annually all while still a high school girl! Furthermore, his class includes Japan's next track star and a national actress, revealing this elite school is actually a gathering place for geniuses. Somehow, these high-spec girls start showing up at Jinpei's house...!?

“Starting today, I'm moving in here too!”

My peaceful solo life after entering high school was shattered in an instant by my childhood friend's surprise move-in, ten years after we last met. What's more, it turns out my new school is apparently a super-prestigious institution where geniuses gather. A high school girl CEO (childhood friend), Japan's track star, a national actress, after listening to these solitary prodigies' troubles, somehow they ended up moving into my place!? Wait, forming an alliance to make me their “shared property”??

“Let's take a bath together like we used to!”
“How about I give you a massage in bed instead?”
“I can't sleep alone...”

The (uninvited) semi-cohabitation life with the beautiful girls who refuse to leave begins!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Now her daily life is so exciting that you could even fill a book with all the stuff she and her friends got up to in between the drama and romance!

Kazuki Tachibana is a high school junior used to helping out with things around the house. While his parents are busy during summer break, he was planning to take care of the cooking, laundry, and watching his little sister. That all goes out the window, though, when he lets Kota Usazaki, the popular boy in class, crash at his place. Kota's known as "The Prince" for being Mr. Perfect... or at least, that's the image he gives off! It turns out he's completely hopeless when it comes to doing chores and navigating romance. Surprised by this unexpected revelation, the open-minded Kazuki takes this opportunity to get to know Kota. However, their budding friendship takes a surprising turn into something more...!

A sweet love story filled with firsts between a pure-hearted prince with zero life skills and a big brother figure who loves to take care of others!

Though it remains a bittersweet memory, Hozumi spends his days struggling to let go of his feelings for Shuutarou, someone he believed he would never see again. Then one day, Shuutarou appears at the high school where Hozumi works, this time as a student teacher...!?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

207669.description:
When he was little, Tado lost his parents in a drowning accident, and has lived with Twi, a baby mermaid he met on the beach. Though they were different species, the two were as close as real siblings, but as Twi grew as a mermaid, life as a human became more difficult. And then the time came for them to part ways. A touching tale of parting between a human brother and a mermaid sister.

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

207671.description:
Jeh Yillo has a highly specific, twisted fetish: he’s obsessed with guys who have terrible personalities and wear glasses. Enter Gwak Changhyeok, the school's most hated grade-level head teacher. When Yillo accidentally witnesses the notoriously toxic teacher speaking softly to his girlfriend, his obsession ignites. He decides to reel him in like a frog in a pot, heating the water so slowly Changhyeok won't even realize he's being boiled alive…until Yillo has the opportunity to devour him whole.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Boiling Frog Syndrome

207672.description:
Baek Hyeon-Woo harbors a secret he must never let his childhood friend Lee Seo-Hun discover. That secret is that he's been secretly in love with Seo-Hun since the moment they first met. As soon as he turned 20, he was practically forced into living together with Seo-Hun, and all he can do is masturbate with a dildo while thinking of him. Living in torment, Hyeon-Woo finds a suspicious app called "Hypnosis" installed on his phone. A sentence he typed in as a joke becomes reality. “Baby.” The hypnosis begins with that one word. Torn between irresistible temptation and guilt, Hyeon-Woo sinks deeper into turmoil.

This dangerous game started with hypnosis. Can Hyeon-Woo ever tell Seo-Hun the truth?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

207676.description:
"I'm a fixer. And today... I begin my first mission."

Ju Si-Young, who even took a leave of absence to become a killer, is finally about to make his historic debut....! But everyone in this neighborhood seems to have lost their minds. What's wrong with this neighborhood? At this rate, I might lose my mind too...?!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

207678.description:
Tae-Ho Jang's stock market scam was supposed to be a sure deal, but something goes terribly wrong and he loses $35 million. The operation was funded by corrupt businessmen and thugs, who are now bent on punishing Tae-ho in retaliation. He must do whatever it takes to save himself and his fiancée before they're both eliminated.

(Source: Tapas)

207679.description:
"No matter how dark it gets, I can still recognize you. I know your scent, your breath, even the way you walk."

My husband, this overly charming tyrant, is utterly deceitful in every way. Even if I've lost my memory, how can I be so wary of the husband I once loved? How can I feel so unfamiliar with him, so afraid? Eun-Sol didn't trust a single thing about him.

(Source: Naver, translated)

207680.description:
“I could entrust my unfinished work to you. Will you continue writing it?”

Graduate student Park Min-Woo inherits the legacy of a world-renowned scholar. The great challenge of a third-rate university humanities student begins!

(Source: Naver, translated)

207681.description:
With the demon sword in hand, he slashes through monstrous beasts...!!

Suddenly appearing in Japan, the ‘Heavenly Prison’. The ‘treasure’ slumbering within this vast labyrinth overrun by monstrous beasts brought prosperity back to Japan. By chance, Jinya Kokucho acquired the “demon sword” needed to survive this dungeon, and whether he liked it or not, he found himself drawn into trouble. Suddenly appearing, a monster called the ‘Angel’ in an isolated prison he cannot leave until he destroys the ‘Nuclear Stone’, and the ‘Void Sword’. Plus, a woman's voice echoing in his mind. Jinya's peaceful days come to an end, and a new life, like a life-or-death tightrope walk, begins...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

207682.description:
Why do angels take the form of monsters?

In this modern age, a colossal tower pierces far beyond the Carman Line a dungeon known as the ‘Celestial Prison’. It is an era where wielding a sword imbued with demonic power, a ‘Demon Sword’, allows one to carve out a life relying solely on brute strength. While many youths aspired to become ‘Demon Sword Masters’, Jinya Kokucho felt no particular interest, instead working diligently at part-time jobs for a shady employer. Ironically, however, he accidentally came into possession of a Demon Sword one day, becoming one of them. Defeating the monsters of the Heavenly Prison, seizing their power, and using it to strengthen both his Demon Sword and himself. As he did so, he gradually came to understand. The peculiar nature of his own Demon Sword, and the reason why the monsters bore the name of angels.

(Source: SB Creative, translated)

Although he's known for disliking women, the prince's prickly attitude slowly begins to thaw as he consumes Carina's delicious cookies and fragrant tea. As they share these relaxing tea breaks together, Carina and the prince find themselves becoming closer and closer...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Shizuno Fujitaka is a lively, talkative party girl. On a day off from work, she agrees to meet up with Kazumi, a person she met through an online game. But, it turns out he's a super negative and gloomy guy due to being overworked at a toxic company! When he makes light of Shizuno for her easygoing nature, she retorts that he's probably just a virgin, only for Kazumi to push her down and hold her close...!

This is a romantic comedy that starts with spicy activities between a busty, tanned party girl and a pessimistic office worker whose first meeting is a disaster!

It's wedding day for the groom-to-be, Aki. While waiting in the changing room, Jun, his childhood friend with whom he had lost contact with, appeared. Aki rises in anger at Jun for stirring up his emotions. However, he's unable to resist the temptation. Once he starts, he can't stop.

Youngsoo and Goran are dating. However, Youngsoo is thrown into turmoil when he discovers Goran's true identity. Will their love ever be fulfilled?

207719.description:
The rising star Eun Do-Hyeon who instantly grabbed attention. His rapid growth and exceptional skills, surpassing his peers, drew uncomfortable stares before cheers. Lacking both awareness and social skills, he constantly clashes within the team. In a world where talent alone isn't enough. The brighter his talent shines, the more tangled his relationships become...

(Source: Naver, translated)

207720.description:
Exhausted after a grueling day at work, Ham Yegyeong drifts into a light sleep during her chaotic evening subway commute. Her peaceful rest is violently shattered when the man sitting next to her, who had seemingly offered his shoulder for her to lean on, suddenly thrusts his middle finger deep into her private opening. Jolted awake and paralyzed by terror, she can barely squeeze out a desperate whisper: .

"S-stop, please stop...".

The predator only offers a cold, mocking smirk.

"Stop what?".

"If you stop, I'll... I'll just pretend this never happened, aaah!".

Yegyeong gasps, her plea cut short as his touch grows even more invasive. To her absolute horror, the nightmare escalates. As she looks up through tears, she realizes that the crowd is shifting, and a group of completely unfamiliar men are slowly closing in, surrounding her seat to seal her fate.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: The Last Train to Hell

207721.description:
Iroha, a member of the Hattori family, whose members have been ninjas for generations, is not doing so well in school and is attending high school. However, her true identity as a ninja is revealed right away at the high school entrance ceremony...!?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

Mio loves cute things and is surrounded by them. One day, her favorite teddy bear breaks! Kojou, who is a member of the crafts club, helps her fix it...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

207724.description:
After a casual comment, Anna begins to give love advice to Kyohei, the man she has a crush on. Even though she knows he has no interest in her, she can't shake her feelings for him...

Lize has served the 13th prince, Noah, since she was a child. One day, she learns that the prince is to marry for political reasons. The prince will be traveling alone to a faraway land, but what are Lize's true feelings...?

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

207730.description:
Stella Crowley was meant to die. But as death beckons, a Grim Reaper named Levi appears before her. Desperate to survive, Stella bargains for three more years of life. Determined to protect her family's legacy, she sets out to find a husband before time runs out. Levi, however, keeps meddling in her affairs, and when the empire's prince takes an interest in her, her plans spiral out of control. With a meddling Grim Reaper by her side and disaster on the horizon, can Stella find her happy ending, or does fate have other plans for her?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: Quando a Morte Pede um Beijo
Un contrat de trois ans avec le faucheur

title.english: 3 Years with the Grim Reaper

207731.description:
This work, overflowing with Yamaguchi's hidden (?) passion, is a slightly risqué comedy manga about a young groper nicknamed "Shake Hip" and the chaos he causes. With his superhuman techniques, the train car is paradise once again today!!

(Source: Fox Shuppan, translated)

207733.description:
Lilrose, known as the most wicked queen in history, was ultimately executed by her husband. But the truth was she was a tragic heroine, forced into a political marriage at just eight years old and torn between the imperial family and her own ducal house. The protagonist possesses Lilrose on her wedding day. To change her unfortunate future, she approaches her husband-to-be, Crown Prince Edmund, with a proposal.

“I don't expect love. Shall we be friends instead?”

She only wanted to avoid death, yet finds herself bewildered by the tyrant family's unexpected doting and her own rapid growth into a high-spec being. A love and healing isekai romance featuring a little girl.

(Source: SORAJIMA, translated)

207740.description:
Terminal illness patient Lu Cha accidentally obtains a mysterious account and transmigrates to a different world called "Extremely Evil Game" to forcibly extend his life. Upon arrival, he becomes the top of the Extremely Evil List and is publicly wanted. In order to escape capture, he randomly jumps into a dungeon only to discover that. as a newbie, he is immediately facing the most dangerous "Ferocious" level trial a high-stakes tug-of-war with an extremely evil monster girl group... Since I'm already here, why not play it big! Isn't this the joy of being alive?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

207743.description:
What should I do if I cross the fantasy world and become the son known as the great traitor of the human race? Don't worry, looking at his infinite epiphany system, all Bai Mo needs to do is make others jealous of him! No matter what kind of exercises or secrets, as long as someone is jealous of him, Bai Mo can open an epiphany and let himself cultivate it to perfection in an instant. So, Bai Mo has a lot of villains around him and occasionally teases them—he liked to watch his enemies jealous and resentful of him, but they couldn't do that themselves!

(Source: KuaiKan, translated)

207746.description:
The connection between humans and gods had long been destroyed, until smartphone salesman Li Xinghe accidentally came across an app called "Heaven's Secrets." From then on, he starts happily selling his phones to the gods. Luckily for him, the gods are friendly and are fascinated with smartphones from the mortal realm!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: I Sell Phones in the Three Realms

207748.description:
It’s a classic setup gone wrong: the neglected boyfriend, the pining younger student, and a hidden exhibitionist streak. When Ji-Su decides to punish his boyfriend Hyeon-Oh by seducing his student Hyeon-Jae, he thinks he’s the one in control. He offers up his pierced body as a playground, only for Hyeon-Oh to walk in and join the fun. Caught in a web of obsession and sibling rivalry, Ji-Su realizes that his birthday wish for more love might have just come true in the most deviant way possible. The game is no longer about jealousy, it's about just how much Ji-Su can handle.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Vrat (38) arrived at the magic school much later than his peers. His dream is to have a "youthful experience." However, his skills as a summoner don't allow it... Will Vrat's dream come true?!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

Yuki's childhood friend, Reisho, has died. However, Reisho's heart has stopped and he has no body temperature, but for some reason he continues to move. Only Yuki knows that he is dead. Then, a ghost from the school comes calling for help...

207752.description:
Princess Liana's new bodyguard, Glory, is a talented knight who became the leader of the Knights at a young age, and he's also incredibly handsome! ...Or so you might think, but he's actually a knight with the weakest mentality, who hates spiders, ghosts, homework, and Mondays...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

207754.description:
Yoo Tae-Gun, the proud underboss of the Blossom Boar Gang, falls unconscious in a fight, only to find himself in a whole new world. While he falls for the beautiful prince Abelian at first sight, there are problems to be solved. For starters, what the hell is an alpha and omega? Second, what does it mean that he’s an apex alpha?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Nagisa, who works at a hotel, secretly has a crush on Misumi, the vice president of a well-known jewelry company. She's content just talking to him every now and then, but one day, when he comes out of his room, she witnesses his "private side"... Then, a certain incident leads Nagisa to make a bold proposal to Misumi...!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

207758.description:
Under the cover of darkness, Dina Ferletti—the young, golden-haired queen of the fiendish Ferletti family—was tossed into a nearby canal and left for dead. The next day, a redhead with “amnesia” washed up on the shore of a rural seaside town. For the past decade, Dina’s lived the charmed life of a nun-in-training, but her blessings seemingly run out when Teodoro, a member of the family, breaks into the chapel. He’s arrived under orders to bring the don’s little sister home, but Teo’s true intentions lie with bringing the Ferlettis to justice. As a result, Dina’s forced to give him a hand by posing as...herself?! And if she’s discovered, her death won’t be staged this time. So God, please let this lie stand!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Ambitious and exceptionally skilled, Gi Se-Na, the divorce specialist who became every rookie lawyer's role model! She endured hardships to proudly inherit her father's law firm, finally securing a partner position... Only to have some tiger-like bastard snatch it away. But that tiger-faced bastard is Ryu Kang-Hyeon, the senior who witnessed Se-Na's embarrassing past in her twenties? She has to successfully marry such a person to inherit the firm?

I have plenty of divorce experience, but I know nothing about romance!

The romance between the unpredictable, ambitious Se-Na and the inscrutable senior Kang-Hyeon begins.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: Divorce is Easy, Dating is Hard
Divorce Is Easy, but Love Is Hard

207767.description:
Number 1 Bully Webtoon Artist Noh Cheol-Min Trapped Inside His Own Webtoon! And as the weakest character in the entire universe! Inside the body of the universe's strongest ‘protagonist’ is his escape assistant?! Can this dysfunctional duo, a personality-crashed bully webtoon artist and his escape assistant, survive the brutal world of bully comics?

(Source: Naver, translated)

207768.description:
Deep in the mountains, where few people venture, Nak-Bin lives alone with his shaman mother. Unlike Nak-Bin, who longs to venture out into the world, his mother always dissuades him. It is precisely because of the immense shamanic power Nak-Bin possesses. She only wishes for her son to live an ordinary life. Despite her efforts, one day, Nak-Bin's power erupts uncontrollably. Nak-Bin summons the gods one after another. His mother desperately fights the gods, but is ultimately overwhelmed by their overwhelming power. Just as a mighty ancient god is about to kill his mother, young Nak-Bin steps forward to block the god.

The god, impressed by his purity and courage, withdraws while simultaneously delivering an ominous prophecy to Nak-Bin. He is the chosen shaman of the ‘Primordial God’, a being who might bring about the world's destruction.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

207770.description:
Miji’s life is a comedy of errors: exploding headphones, train accidents, the works. Her theory? She's cursed. Her solution? Summoning a powerful demon. But the price for breaking the curse is her future partner's life! A fantastic deal, Miji thinks. Who needs love anyway? Right?

(Source: Manta)

title.english: Killing My Honey

207771.description:
Princess Arca is betrayed by the one person she thought she could trust, resulting in the murder of her entire family and a tragic end to her first life. Given a second chance, Arca does whatever she can to not let the past repeat itself, including entering a contract with the demon duke Mayhem. Mayhem is willing to help Arca obtain a happy ending for her family. However, it will come at the price of Arca giving up her own happiest memories...

(Source: Tappytoon)

207773.description:
Negoro Kaito is a young man who is reincarnated into another world after saving a cat.

However, his appearance was unmistakably that of a cat.

Now that he's become a cheaty cat, he seeks a life with three meals a day and a nap in another world!

207775.description:
"One year of living with him..."

Young Miharu is born into a family that had purified Ayakashi for generations. But Miharu can't handle the supernatural and even lacks the sense and powers to purify Ayakashi. His grandfather, the one and only close family he has, passes away, leaving Miharu to fend for himself against not just the cruel Ayakashi that torture him, but also the neglectful relatives who want nothing to do with him. One day, a human-hating, rude, and rough demon called Kochi appears. Shot with a cursed arrow on his back, Kochi is here for Miharu, who is the key to relieving him from his curse. But to his surprise, Miharu also reveals that he, too, is cursed...

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

He wipes them all out in one satisfying sweep! The rookie days of the monster detective, Ma Seok-Do! A covert operation begins to take down the worst and strongest crime syndicate.

207784.description:
Moving into her dream apartment was supposed to be a relief for Yuri, but choosing a moving company proved to be a total headache. Desperate, she takes a recommendation from her assistant manager and books a service that promises to handle everything. But when the movers arrive, Yuri realizes she accidentally selected the premium package. These gorgeous men aren’t just here to unpack boxes - they’re ready to deliver an unforgettable, full-service experience that caters to her every desire. Moving day just got a lot more hands-on.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Full Service Moving

207785.description:
Nina had always admired Mao, her senpai from high school. Mao was a diehard rock fan and talented musician who was as gentle as she was strong-willed. When it came time for Nina to pick universities, of course she wanted to follow Mao. But when the two finally reunite, Mao is almost a completely different person...and she's quit music! While Nina is happy to learn about how her precious senpai has grown, there's one problem: the guy who causes Mao to look so soft and tender. But this nice-looking-guy isn't treating Mao the way Nina believes she deserves. Her solution? Show Mao-senpai just how she deserves to be treated by taking her out!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

207791.description:
Born gay, born single Kang Woo-Jin. He's been secretly in love with Choi Yi-Tae, the transfer student he met in his second year of high school, all the way to his current age of thirty. Kang Woo-Jin couldn't betray the friendship he shared with Choi Yi-Tae during their youthful days, convincing himself it was okay to remain just friends. But when Choi Yi-Tae starts pestering him to move in together, Kang Woo-Jin finds himself facing an unavoidable dilemma.

“I'm gay.”

“What does you being gay have to do with us living together?”

Dragged into cohabitation, Kang Woo-Jin begins living with him. Months later, an incident finally pushes him past the line of friendship.

“Kang Woo-Jin, how do you have sex with a guy?”

There was no way he knew. He'd tried with other men, but never followed through. He could only think of this guy right in front of him. It had been 13 years of unrequited love. Now that we've crossed the line of friendship, what exactly are we?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

207792.description:
Kim Hana lived a loveless life and died miserably from an illness. Only after death did she learn her life had been set incorrectly from the start! To fix this error, she is reborn as Flora Percy, the youngest child of House Percy, and is surrounded by the love she never knew before. Flora comes from a powerful family that excels in magic and swordsmanship, but she alone is fragile, her powers still dormant. Can she flourish in this life, or is she doomed again?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 북부 공작가의 설정값 오류 막내 공녀님

207793.description:
In the modern era, dungeons and monsters appear, and awakened humans emerge. The awakened, possessing extraordinary power and abilities, became hunters to protect the world, and a power structure formed around them. But this was all irrelevant to Mu-Jin... or was it? Due to his female friend Ji-Su, who had returned, Mu-Jin's life, which had sought normality, changed spectacularly!

Sixteen-year-old Mu-Jin receives a thunderbolt confession from Ji-Su, his childhood friend he's known since they were little. She claims to have returned from a distant future where an evil organization conquered the world, making it a dreadful place to live. She says the Mu-Jin she saw before dying crushed enemies with overwhelming power. Therefore, “You... become my comrade!” Though this absurd confession makes Mu-Jin slightly concerned about Ji-Su's mental state, his arrogant conceit, thinking a hunter's life might be fun, leads him to enroll in the Hunter Academy. A born genius with a body of steel and sharp wit, the ultimate overpowered munchkin Mu-Jin enters the academy with outstanding grades despite minimal training and becomes a disciple of the King of Power.

The only thing different from the past is Mu-Jin. Even so, can Ji-Su change a future destined only for destruction?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

207795.description:
Mika Eto, a corporate slave designer at a major company, should have ended her life from overwork. Instead, she reincarnates as Minuet Rubain, a baroness facing an arranged marriage. Minuet hadn't wanted the marriage, but learning her partner was the Crown Prince changed everything. Delighted at the prospect of a life of luxury, she cheered, “Long live arranged marriages!” However, the portrait she receives shows a elementary school student?! And the royal family is facing financial difficulties! Minuet impulsively refuses the marriage, only to be branded in the newspapers as “the insolent woman who rejected marriage,” sending her reputation plummeting. All she wanted was to live peacefully in this life... Driven to desperation, Minuet tries to seduce a man she meets at a party, but... Can she truly grasp the “ordinary romance” she desires?

(Source: Weaven, translated)

A man, Shim Cheong, cast into the deepest depths of the sea by humans' greed to calm the raging waves. Contrary to what he had imagined from the rough waves, the Dragon King he met in person was exceedingly benevolent. The innocent and pure Shim Cheong gained the Dragon King's favor, and the two began to grow close in both body and soul...

(Source: Naver, translated)

Bethia, the poor baron's adopted daughter, has spent her life as a mere tool, enduring cruel abuse. But one day, she unexpectedly crosses paths with a mysterious duke at the temple. Upon hearing her name, the duke desperately pleads with her to become his daughter-in-law!

To make things even crazier, her supposed fiancé is willing to hand over all his wealth to her. Wait, what? Is everyone around here out of their minds? Why is all this happening to me?

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: 全ては公爵様の思い通りに

title.english: At the Duke's Command

207799.description:
Carole has a burn scar on her face from an accident that happened during her childhood. Saying that she is ugly, her family looks down on her and treats her like a servant. One day, when she slips and bumps her head, she regains her memory from her past life. Carole remembers that she was a beauty consultant, an expert on makeup and beauty. Using her knowledge on beauty, she begins to turn her miserable life around!

(Source: Manga Plaza)

Belona Rosentin had been living peacefully as a mere side character in a novel until she became trapped in a death loop that reset regardless of her choices. Desperate to end her agony, she tries a new gamble: stop the novel’s villain, Deminic Roxellen, from meeting his tragic end. But as he opens his heart to her, guilt and unease creep in, forcing her to remember why she chose to help him. Belona is here to break the cycle, not grow attached only to die and lose everything again!

Due to a bitter rivalry, professional baseball players Jo Jin and Hyang-Gi view each other as enemies. Both planning quiet retirements from their respective teams, they suddenly exchange punches during a game, engaging in a brawl that goes down in pro baseball history and gets them released from their teams. Now, they've set their sights on returning to the professional ranks—a comeback everyone says is impossible. They've resolved to run the bases once more. 207819.description:
After a rough breakup, Yamagi's grief has grown as a chronic online shopping addiction. His life takes a surreal turn when a bag was swapped on the train with a collection of adult toys. The owner, Amane Ishikura, is a charismatic proprietor of an adult novelty shop. Upon discovering Yamagi is a writer, Ishikura offers a proposition to write reviews for his products. But the research is more hands-on than Yamagi bargained for. With a whisper and a touch, Ishikura challenges him: “Online shopping doesn't hold a candle to this. You might just get addicted."

Can a serious, lonely writer find a cure for his emptiness in the arms of a dry pragmatist?

(Source: CLLENN)

207827.description:
Ryutaro Inukai is an talent manager, and he is pushed to his limits—mentally and physically—by his selfish and cold “ice cold idol” client, Koori.

On the very day he finally writes his resignation letter, Koori suddenly tells him, “I’ll be retiring in six months to marry my fiancé.”

Just as Ryutaro feels a wave of relief, Koori unexpectedly begins treating him kindly, and her once icy attitude slowly starts to melt.

To make matters even more complicated, a No.1 blonde idol and a serious, class-rep-type idol also get involved with Ryutaro!?

What are the true feelings hidden behind that icy cold exterior…?

Amber, the only daughter of an Earl, was married to Brandon of a Marquis family in an arranged marriage. Amber went along with the condition of the marriage that Brandon would manage the Earl's assets, but he had no talent for the job, squandered the fortune, and even eloped with a maid. However, Amber secretly worked a side job behind her ex-husband's back, and used that experience to start a series of businesses, including a clothing store, a beauty salon, and a bar. Just when she was delighted that each business was on track, a certain truth came to light and she found herself in a difficult position. Then, a beautiful young man, the mysterious painter Christian, appeared and made a surprising proposal...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

207839.description:
Long, long ago, deep within the towering forest, there existed a world inhabited only by humanoids. Among them, two adjacent mountains were home to the Fox Tribe and the Wolf Tribe, living separately. The beastmen from these two tribes fought constantly, like sworn enemies, and caught in the crossfire was the small village of herbivorous beastmen nestled between the mountains.

“Please stop fighting! If this keeps up, we'll all pack up and move away!!”

Finally, the furious herbivore-type humanoids declared a strike, forcing the Fox Tribe and Wolf Tribe to prepare a wedding for peace. Thus, Hwang Mi-Ho of the Fox Tribe and Jang Woo-Rang of the Wolf Tribe were chosen as representatives of their tribes and bound in matrimony.

“What?! You have no shame?! How could you...”

“What's so terrible about spending the first night together? Ah, could this be your first time?”

They intended to create harmony through marriage, but will this truly lead to a happy ending... for everyone?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

207841.description:
My first love murdered my family.

“...Why on earth did you do that?”

“I did it for you.”

Facing Sung Ji-Seong, who was released early after receiving a special pardon without even serving his full sentence, Jo Ye-Seong resolves to kill him with his own hands. But stabbing Ji-Seong, his first love, with his own hands isn't easy...

207843.description:
Seihou Takizawa immerses readers in World War II. In this new book, he brings to life two pilots from the Imperial Japanese Navy Air Service who flew Nakajima B5N torpedo bombers from the Battle of Pearl Harbor (December 1941) to the Battle of the Santa Cruz Islands (October 1942).

(Source: Paquet, translated)

207844.description:
Since the beginning of the 20th century, all wars have had their share of aviators. Initially observers, they became important, even major, players in conflicts. Seiho Takizawa takes us from World War I to the Iran-Iraq War in the early 1980s, bringing us closer than ever to the combatants in the skies. A major new work from one of Japan's masters of aviation storytelling! Shah's pilot is based on the accounts of Iranian F-14 pilots during the Iran-Iraq War, a little-known story. The F-14 Tomcat, an American-built fighter jet that can be admired in the film Top Gun, was the spearhead of the Iranian air force, with 79 aircraft delivered by the United States just before the 1979 revolution that saw the Shah of Iran ousted from power by Islamists. The other stories also focus on little-known military exploits, such as the epic tale of the Messerschmitt Me 323 Gigant in the Mediterranean and Count von Rosen's involvement in air combat in Africa in the 1970s.

(Source: Paquet, translated)

A deadly curse is slowly killing Teo, and none of the healers or magic users he's ever met have been able to help him - until one day, during his travels, he finds the natural spirit Arvahany.

Arvahany hates humans and has secrets of his own, not the least of which is that he has lost a considerable part of his powers. Teo has something he wants, and so he binds him with a contract to save himself, promising Teo to break his curse at the end of it, as a reward. But will the two be able to save each other? It might be much harder than either of them thought...

207862.description:
"Do you think you could fall for me?"

After her mere three-year marriage ends in divorce, Akari Kitagawa returns to her old workplace. But as her ex-husband used to work there, she's questioned by the prying, gossip-loving older staff, some even suggesting the split was her fault. Just then, Takaya Makimura-her former junior colleague-nominates himself as her fiancé in front of everyone.

"He used to be such a sweet coworker. How could he say something so outrageous?!" Akari confronts him, only to find he said it on the spur of the moment to defuse the awkward situation. She demands he take it back, but Takaya refuses, saying it's too late. "Instead, you might as well fall for me for real," he says, stealing a kiss from her lips. Akari is taken aback, but his passionate kiss breaks down her will to resist...

"It's too late to back out now."

What will become of Akari?! A fake proposal from her junior coworker sets off a whirlwind romance, where truth and pretense become entwined.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Misaki, born into the prestigious Kinhou family, is in training to become a priestess and follow her family's footsteps by devoting herself to protecting the country. Little do they know, Misaki harbors a hidden power that allows her to control spirits through a hole in her hand. Despite her impressive, overwhelming ability, she hides the truth from the world, afraid that her family will covet her powers. Her life becomes entangled with the supernatural occurrences across the city and it is up to her to save everyone...while keeping her secret hidden!

Now she must live with a stranger she has to call her husband, and against her will, she begins to fall helplessly in love with him. What better way than time travel? A mysterious creature tied to her dad's past offers to transport her back in time and to his world. The only catch is they arrive before she was born! Can Tiae find her dad when he doesn't even know her? Maybe her new mercenary friends and newly awakened necromancer powers can help her out...

207876.description:
Welcome to the inner palace, where only the most skilled and diligent maids are stationed to wait on the king's consorts and their children. Fina Scalchi is one such maid. The problem is that she despises the cold climate of the royal capital. She's managed to put up with the frigid temperatures for the past five years (with the help of aphrodisiacs), but she's had enough! So when she's finally offered an assignment in the warmer South, you can imagine how ecstatic she is. The caveat, however, is that she must work at the southern military fortress ruled by the "Stone Cold General," Silverio Orcagna. Despite her distaste for his arrogant demeanor, she remains the dutiful maid, impressing him with her dedication. Then one evening, when the general visits Fina's room, he mistakenly partakes in her precious aphrodisiac! Unable to bear the sight of him in his heated state, she aids him...in quelling his fervor. But as a result of their close-quarters contact, a sense of possessiveness begins to take hold of the general...!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

"I'm pretty amazing, you know?" "With me, you'd be even more powerful." The pair that has it all have an S-rank adventure and romance! An isekai rom-com! Alicia is a haughty duchess who likes to cake her face with makeup. On the night before her banishment for bullying the heroine, Alicia remembers she is a villainess in an otome game... While feeling at a loss, she realizes something else. She has big breasts, good looks, and magical powers?! Who knew she was a triple threat! An idea dawned upon her, and she sought out her nerdy brother to be his assistant to research magical tools. Alicia displayed her talent and soon longed for a life of fun and freedom, rather than the strict upbringing of a queen. In the end, Alicia decides to live her life as a commoner... And she gets teased by the S-rank adventurer, Hayato?! An isekai rom-com with an S-rank adventure and romance!

Adiyah was born as the next Holy Maiden of Awakening, inheriting the power to banish demons known as Dream Thieves. However, her younger sister conspires with a Dream Thief to steal those powers, leaving Adiyah to be disparaged as "the impotent holy maiden." Caught in her sister's cunning trap, she is terrorized by her peers and family alike, cast aside by her fiancé, and left with nothing. After years of this torment, she reunites with a boy she saved in a dream world when she was young... and he turns out to be an imperial prince?!

She had worked so hard as an apothecary to support him, only to be treated like this… As Rayfel sinks into despair, her own parents try to torment her even further. 207884.description:
Elizabeth, the daughter of a duke, has memories of her past life. However, all she remembers are her favorite fighting games!? It's knowledge that seems useless in this world... Well, it's no use, so she'll just live her life as it comes.

(Source: Bushiroad, translated)

207885.description:
Ruri is your average preschool teacher, until one day she is enveloped in a blinding light and is transported to another world! While she's still in shock, Lina, a shy young girl, takes her by the hand and becomes attached to her. Before she knows it, she's become her private tutor! Until she can make it back to her world, she decides to accept her role, but she suddenly awakens her exceptional magic skills! In truth, Ruri is the rumored "Third Saint" that has been summoned to save this world! Follow Ruri in this fantastical story as she tries to balance her duty as a Saint when all she wants is to live alongside children!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

207887.description: Suddenly, she was told that her engagement to the second prince had been called off. In her previous life, Sarana Kinje, the daughter of a countess, was a single aristocratic office worker, but in this life, her engagement is broken off and she and her family leave King's Landing for a neighboring country. In her next life, a quiet life awaits her, but she is busy making things and doing business. "Oh, my God, I find myself completely active!"
synonyms: Reincarnated as Sarana Kinje. Good Day to You: A Gracefully Hectic Slow Life

title.romaji: Tensei Shimashita, Sarana Kinje desu. Gokigen You.: Yuuga na Slow Life de Ooisogashi

207888.description:
When one man is reborn into a fantasy novel as the villain doomed for disaster, he decides to take fate into his own hands. Can he rewrite his destiny, or is he meant for ruin?

Luke Witharia Gilbert has been reborn into the world of a fantasy novel as the arrogant villain destined for a disastrous end. But Luke isn’t willing to play the hero’s ultimate fall guy. Armed with monstrous abilities, he enrolls at Aslan Magic Academy with a single goal: to become the strongest student and avoid his villainous fate. However, rewriting his story and shaking up the delicate balance of character dynamics is easier said than done. Luckily, Luke’s growing charisma and power make him a magnetic force, drawing everyone to his side—ranging from heroines to high nobles to even those scheming in the shadows. It seems like he may just sidestep his bad ending. But even the smallest change threatens to send the entire narrative into chaos. Can Luke rewrite his fate, or is his disastrous destiny inevitable?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment, edited)
synonyms: The Deeds of an Extremely Arrogant Villainous Noble

title.english: The Misdeeds of an Extremely Arrogant Villain Aristocrat
