title.romaji: Kiwamete Goumantaru Akuyaku Kizoku no Shogyou

207890.description:
"I left your memories behind because that's the only way this world can endure. Emo, you are the only one who can save the world."

The war was won, but the wheat harvest was a total disaster! The Ripolka Empire, struck by a great famine due to the curse cast by the defeated Demon King in his final moments after losing to the hero. I, Eudemonian Plenus, was born into this land bearing the historical mission of advancing the continent's food culture, carrying the knowledge of my past life! People starve to death with nothing to eat, yet they refuse to eat potatoes, sweet potatoes, or tomatoes... The young lord's continental version of the ‘Three Meals a Day’ project!

“Young Master was born with a blessing for food. Though my power is weak and I could not see the vision for long, countless foods I had never seen in my lifetime existed in Young Master's future. He will live his entire life without hunger, eating delicious things to his heart's content.”

What good is being a sage in spirit if my body is that of a baby? Can I really do this? Oh dear, this is bad!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

207891.description:
To lure her widowed sister-in-law into depravity, Song Zhimei resorted to every unscrupulous tactic imaginable. One night, she stumbled into her sister-in-law's secret chamber. Within lay two rooms: one locked away her long-lost elder brother, the other a golden cage filled with her sister-in-law's treasured possessions. The usually fragile woman now blocked her path, chains in hand... Who, truly, was the prey?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: I Happened to Arrive in Spring

title.romaji: Pian Wo Lai Shi Qia Feng Chun

207892.description:
Shen Qingshuang is a “Guanyin” from a distinguished family, yet a caged beast in seclusion; Mu Yunzhao is a “Rakshasa” from a military lineage, yet a lone wolf in the capital. She despises the Rakshasa for defying orthodoxy, she loathes the Guanyin for her haughty rigidity. Yet unbeknownst to her, the Guanyin dreams only of tearing off her robes, burning her precepts, and plunging into the abyss with her; the Rakshasa harbors a heart set on weaving a net, bewitching sacred chants, and clinging to her until death. Will the Guanyin subdue the demon, or will the demon subdue the Guanyin? The answer lies hidden in that springtime first encounter—the Rakshasa holding the reins, the Guanyin's strings in disarray...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: Flirty Teasing by Your Jade Fingers

title.english: Jade Seduction

207893.description:
After being reborn, an elite police officer becomes a prisoner and is taken in by his nemesis. Amidst suspicion and entanglement, the two eventually become accomplices in their shared fate.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

207894.description:
The Scheming Fake Eunuch X The Madly Infatuated Prince.

Reborn and returned, they don masks for their own purposes—mutually distrustful yet irresistibly drawn to each other. Amidst suspicion and testing, they soberly succumb to their attraction.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

207895.description:
Ye Qi, a disciple of the Kunlun Sect, descended the mountain on his master's orders to investigate the disappearance of his senior sister. Venturing alone into the Demon Cult, he unexpectedly rescued a man imprisoned in a secret chamber. The man's bones were shattered, his condition pitiful beyond description. Ye Qi tended to his every need, changing his bedpans, feeding him, and even transported him to Kongsang Valley for medical care. Just as Ye Qi was filled with profound admiration for the man's indomitable spirit despite his crippling injuries, he discovered the prisoner was none other than the Demon Cult's leader he had been searching for!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Tianxia Shei Ren Bu Shi Jun

207896.description:
Cybernetic enhancements, AI girlfriends, neural networks, cyberspace—this is a world of hyper-advanced technology where innovations can transform your life like magic. While incurable cancers of the past are now insignificant before nanomedicine robots, new technological heights also breed all manner of fresh problems, new troubles, and new... cyberpsychosis. “What is capitalism?” Jack Sun stood with hands on hips, leaning back.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

207897.description: Marie was born into one of the two great Saint lineages. She endured an upbringing that was nearly abusive in order to hone her healing powers. However, the one chosen as the Saint was Julia, who had gained the people’s support thanks to her beauty. In despair, Marie is assigned the position of Saint’s assistant. But Julia barely fulfills her duties as Saint and forces onto Marie all kinds of tasks far beyond what an assistant should handle. In the midst of this painful situation, the one who reaches out to her is Cecil, the second prince, who has just returned to the kingdom after studying abroad. “From now on, I’ll be the one to protect you.” Even though they had almost no connection before, Cecil treats Marie with a surprising amount of care—so much so that she begins to wonder if he might actually be doting on her. Even though she wasn’t chosen as the Saint, Marie’s life slowly begins to shine…
synonyms: Even Though I Wasn't Supposed to Be Chosen as a Saint
I Wasn't Meant to Be the Saintess
I Wasn't Supposed to Be Chosen as the Saint, Yet Here I Am

207898.description:
Kirara, a modern-day Japanese high school girl who has lived her life as a "gal," suddenly finds herself in another world as Chelsea, a "failed young lady." Unaware of the common sense of aristocratic society, unfamiliar with the rules of reincarnation in another world, and with no allies due to her younger sister Jennifer's schemes, Kirara/Chelsea finds herself in a hopeless position. Nevertheless, she sets out to somehow turn the situation around. She seeks instruction from a tutor who is known for his strictness, and Chelsea overcomes the tutoring with her natural guts, and her reputation in high society skyrockets! She also becomes close with Crown Prince Valentino and those around him...!?

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

207899.description:
As the illegitimate daughter of a count and his maid, Katrina was born into miserable circumstances. And now that she's lost her mother, the treatment from her stepsister and stepmother the countess has only grown worse. One day, her stepsister receives a royal order to move to the northern outskirts due to her unseemly behavior at a recent party. There, she is to learn proper conduct under the tutelage of the resident prince, rumored to be a cruel man. Not wanting to subject her daughter to such punishment, the countess decides to send Katrina instead. Katrina arrives in the north shaking in fear. But contrary to the stories, the "merciless and cold-hearted" prince is kinder than she believed. Might the pure-hearted Katrina find love in the wintry countryside?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

207905.description:
The cafe master, a phantom thief, even organized criminals are head over heels with you!?

Every night, police inspector Kumi is utterly defeated by a phantom thief who gallantly appears and takes off with various treasures. To relieve the stress and fatigue of her work, she finds solace in master of the cafe she frequents. But, one day, she falls victim to a trap set by wanted criminals and her chastity is put in danger! Just before the crime boss creep lays his hands on her supple body, who should appear but...!?

(Source: DLsite)

207908.description:
Just when he thought his life had completely fallen apart… What awaited him instead was— a team of unpredictable, dangerously charming older moms?! “Coach~ you do know things bounce when I run… right? ♥” The soccer field is turning into a chaotic stage where hidden desires and mischievous romance start to tangle together… A reckless new coach × beginner players who are married or single moms— and a training ground where the tension never dies down. A whirlwind of lust, chaos, and complicated relationships. With these voluptuous single mothers by his side, he sets out to challenge the national tournament! A wild, unpredictable body-driven relationship between a rookie coach and his rookie players— No one knows where this will lead next…!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

207912.description:
In the prestigious Academy of Magic & Arcana, Sophia stands out as an honor student. Her younger sister, Mia, consumed by jealousy over Sophia's success, has sabotaged three of her marriage proposals. After her latest engagement is ruined, Sophia grows weary of Mia's wrath. Just then, Luke, the crown prince of a neighboring country, reaches out to her. The two quickly bond over their shared love of magic, becoming a hot topic at the academy. Determined to prevent Sophia from finding happiness, Mia prepares to make her move...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Momoka is an ugly sex worker that has clients rushing in with big wads of cash. But she doesn't flirt with the men; it's quite the opposite. Men want her, so they come and flirt with her! One day Momoka visits a brothel as a special instructor for newbies. That's when she meets and saves a woman who was tricked into joining the brothel by her boyfriend...

207916.description:
Erika is married to a loving husband and blessed with a child; she should be feeling nothing but happiness. However, things begin to fall apart when she returns to work after her maternity leave... Erika must take care of the irregularities of her child and do all the major housework. She's left to endure parenting all by herself, and she begins to feel dissatisfied with her husband, who's only felt the need to focus on his work up until this point...

207919.description:
The saint who saved the world, and what happened afterwards. Saint Meizey was cursed as the price for defeating the Demon King. One year to live that was the price. To break the curse, she needed “a kiss from a lover,” but her fiancé Harman didn't believe she would return and had married another woman! Having lost both hope and love, returning home would only mean being used as a tool by her family. In this situation, Meisy asked herself for the first time:

“Isn't it okay to live the rest of my life just for myself?”

Bathed in golden light, Meisy abandoned her role as the “Saint” and set out on her journey. The saint who saved the world is now living just for herself!

(Source: SORAJIMA, translated)
synonyms: After Saving the World, I Decline the Marriage Proposal

To commemorate Sho-Comi's 50th anniversary, this one-shot story—Chie Shinohara's first appearance in the magazine in 16 years—unfolds an alternate story leading into the fifth paperback volume. It depicts an episode from the journey of Prince Zannanza, brother of Prince Kail, as he travels to marry the Egyptian queen.

(Source: Comic Natalie, translated)

207922.description:
My first love, who helped me find my dream, turned out to be my shy anti-fan. Yet I can't bring myself to hate him... Why is that? The drama they starred in together as child actors, Once Upon a Winter, and the affectionate Tae-Won were Yi-Hyeon's first love and his entire world. Holding onto his words that she might be good as a singer, Yi-Hyeon became an idol and reunites with Tae-Won upon hearing news of Once Upon a Winter 2's production. But behind his gentle smile, Tae-Won seems somehow hollow. The moment he chased after him to stop his sudden departure he witnessed Tae-Won inside an open car with a strange man.

“Need someone to play along? Then keep filming, hyung. I'll do it.”

As the plot twists into an increasingly complex mess,Yi-Hyeon and Tae-Won's relationship becomes tangled too...!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

207923.description:
The 21st-century Korean Empire, where absolute monarchy persists. After the Crown Prince and Princess were assassinated, the royal family concealed the princess's existence completely. Then, thirteen years later, a transfer student named Do-Yeong appears before ordinary high schooler Hyeon-U, claiming to be the princess. Is Do-Yeong truly the princess? Or is this yet another deception? The royal family, the resistance, and the hidden heir. The truth surrounding the throne begins to unfold.

(Source: Naver, translated)

207924.description:
The male lead, who had been repeatedly reincarnating, went mad and turned the entire empire into a sea of flames. I ended up possessing the body of a character in the web novel If You Pick Up a Sword, You Might as Well Slit Someone's Throat...And of all things, I became one of the countless saintesses. My goal is singular...

(Source: Naver, translated)

207926.description:
Haruka Usami is a 24 year old office worker with an honest and hard-working attitude. Her boss, Tsukasa Ogami, is a serious man with eyes like a wolf. She's beginning to feel fed up with her boss's strictness, when she has to continue working after her ex-boyfriend has left her with a horrible loan to pay off! While working another job as a mascot character, she runs into her boss by chance! "I want to help my staff to work and grow together. There's someone in our office who does so much for us..." She gets to hear her boss's true thoughts!? It turns out her serious boss is a softy who's no good with talking to people. Now that she knows, she can't help but find him adorable. Now Haruka has to figure out how to express these feelings to him! What will happen in this odd office love story??

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Mr. Ogami's Tender Kiss: The Secret Side of my Strict Boss

title.romaji: Ookami Kachou no Kiss wa Amai: Reitetsu Joushi no Ura no Kao

207927.description:
"Today, I get to marry the man I love... but he doesn't love me." Lilia, a princess from the Ehre Kigndom, has admired Prince Oscar of the Glanz Kingdom for the longest time. However, it was decided early on that older sister, Isabella, would be the one to marry him due to her beauty and pride. Lilia had given up on the dream, but one day Isabella suddenly called off her betrothment. As someone of the Ehre royal family must marry into the Glanz Kingdom for continued peace, Lilia is now set to take the place of her older sister. Lilia is full of joy and concern all the same, but it feels as though this marriage sits in a shadow cast by Isabella, now looming over them. Prince Oscar seems to be distant, unconcerned with things, and Lilia is now buried in preparations as the crown princess. What will happen in this new and complicated relationship?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Dishes, people, and time aplenty.

207929.description:
"I'm living on the green side of the grass."

Successful career woman Sono never let envy drag her down. She had everything she ever wanted, and she'd gotten it all through her own hard work. On top of her growing list of accomplishments at work, her relationship with her boss (and live-in boyfriend) Taiya was going great, with a proposal right on the horizon...until one unexpected twist brought her whole perfect life tumbling down around her. Heartbroken and needing an escape, Sono moved to a run-down little apartment, only to realize it had a secret hole in the wall that looked straight into the neighboring apartment. When she sees what the neighbor is getting up to, she can't seem to look away, and as the days pass she finds herself more and more obsessed with peeking in on her neighbor...

A mature love story about a career woman intent on being "strong and independent," the mysterious boy next door, and their slowly intertwining lives.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Eyeing Shiba from Next Door
title.native: 隣の芝くんは見せてくれない
title.romaji: Tonari no Shiba-kun wa Misete Kurenai

207930.description:
Miyu ties the knot after being urged to do so by her father. Kei, her husband and first love, is an heir to an old money conglomerate. She has looked up to him ever since she was little. It had always been a dream of Miyu's to get married...but Kei has yet to touch her. Heck, she doesn't even have his permission for them to live together. Six years have passed, and now Miyu has decided to get a divorce to put an end to her lonely days. But in the middle of asking for a divorce, Kei tells her that he can't hold back anymore, and he starts showering her with love?! Why did he keep his distance all these years, and why is he trying to show his love now? Kei's extremely clumsy attempts at showing his deep love for Miyu will have you swooning non-stop!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Sorry, But I Have No Intention of Giving You Up: A Ruthless Heir's Overflowing Love

207931.description:
Richelle is your average lady of nobility: charming and madly in love with her busy fiancé. However, on her way to the palace to give him some treats she baked to help him get through the day she spots him kissing another lady that he was initially working with! After being ridiculed for making baked goods, the engagement was called off. However, a handsome margrave named Lucien comes across her snacks, and after tasting them cannot help but express how refreshing they were. Now begins a fresh romance between the charmed margrave, and totally unaware sweets connoisseur!

(Source: MangaPlaza, edited)

title.english: Decadent Treats and His Sweet Affection: A Viscount's Daughter with a Broken Engagement, Showered with Love by the Margrave's Son

207932.description:
After restoring her memories, Samara realizes she's been reincarnated as the villain in her favorite dating-sim game. She also remembers that every road this character takes leads to her death by the age of 16! To rewrite this tragic fate, Samara attempts to get in good with her father, the world's strongest mage. However, her usual selfish antics have made her father grow cold and distant from Samara...! Ever determined, Samara puts in work to win the love and affection of her otherwise cool and standoffish father! Let this grand adventure in reincarnation and strategic planning begin!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Reincarnated Little Villainess Becomes the Beloved Daughter of a Mean Daddy
title.native: 転生悪役幼女は最恐パパの愛娘になりました

207937.description:
I was reincarnated as a villainous princess who becomes obsessed with the "Divine Wolf Hero" and is killed!? Luna, the youngest princess of a small country, realizes that this is the world of a novel she read in her previous life. the divine wolf prince Rudolf can't find a mate. Love is needed to stop his rampage, but the "real heroine" who plays that role in the novel loses her life. The murder of the princess repeats. Luna, destined to be hated by Rudolph, is ordered by him to "play the role of a fake mate"... but for some reason, he ends up falling in love with her to the point of drowning!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

207938.description:
The ducal family killed her sister. They destroyed her whole world. Now Summer has nothing—except her life. And now every moment of it is pointed towards one thing: revenge. Undercover as the noblewoman Adele, Summer slips into the Duke's home as an aide to his youngest son. From up close, she can finally enact her vengeance. But Summer is too close. Instead of avenging her sister, she finds herself falling for the very man she meant to destroy. Can his love overcome her pain? Is that justice?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Dear My Sweet Bastard

207939.description:
Tae-Ho, who works as a bodyguard, happens to meet Seo-Hun at a cafe. Seo-Hun is the cafe owner and also runs an ASMR video channel that helps Tae-Ho overcome his insomnia. After that, Tae-Ho keeps visiting the cafe ‘Sweet Pie’ to see Seo-Hun and enjoy sweet desserts, but Seo-Hun suspects the suspicious and fierce-looking Tae-Ho is his stalker...

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

207952.description:
“There must be only one sun.”

“Two suns would only burn the empire's people to death.”

Alexar, the Archmage who once commanded the empire. After being betrayed by his trusted and loyal friend, Gillian Tercios, he is reborn as a reckless swordsman in a small, remote fiefdom. To exact bloody vengeance upon Gillian, his once-beloved friend and the continent's sole 9-star swordsman, Archmage Alexar begins his move.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

207954.description:
As Sia unpacks her life into a new home, she uncovers her grandmother's diary. It speaks of a mysterious man who gifted her grandmother tea leaves laced with otherworldly powers. Intrigued and desperate to unravel the tale, Sia digs deeper and hears whispers of a mansion—a place said to be the dwelling of a reclusive individual plagued by mental anguish. Some even claim it's the prison of a man ensnared by witch hunts long ago. Compelled by this swirl of dark rumors, Sia takes the daring step to visit the mansion, a house shrouded in secrets and sealed away for decades.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: I Moogie You: A Slippery Love

207959.description:
The man her sister forced upon her was the perfect husband, even cuter and more handsome on the inside than he looks!

"I really wanted to go, you know? But no matter how you look at it, we're not a good match. So you go, I'm sure you'd suit each other." Mimosa, the second daughter of Viscount Norton, is to marry the obese next Earl, whose portrait looks deceiving no matter how you look at it, in place of her beautiful sister. Unlike her glamorous and sociable sister, Mimosa is a shy, reclusive 17-year-old who is not only shy but also reclusive. Since the Earl's family preferred her sister, you'd think she'd be turned away immediately, but...huh?! She's actually welcomed with open arms!? A love story between a timid young lady and a pure-hearted knight, beginning with their newlywed life!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

Note: Includes ten extra chapters.

207960.description:
They Started Working as Hitmen Because They Couldn't Fit in Society

Chisato Sugimoto and Mahiro Fukugawa are a duo of hitmen who excel at killing but struggle to fit in with society. One day, Mahiro notices someone tailing her and kills the suspicious man. However, this encounter leads the two to become embroiled in an epic project being carried out by the Hitmen's Association...!? This hit drama has been adapted into a comic, with full supervision by director Yugo Sakamoto and new episodes added. A new "Baby Assassins" begins!

(Source: U-Next, translated)

title.native: ベイビーわるきゅーれ エブリデイ！

207961.description:
1000 years since the end of "The War to End All" and the destruction of the history of mankind. Ragdis-Hart is known as an "Explorer," and risks his life in the labyrinths of ruins crawling with ferocious security bots. Much to his dismay, he spends his days fighting solo, unable to find a party willing to accept an "Enhancer," as they have a reputation for being inefficient. However, his destiny is about to change. One fateful day at the Tower of Lunaticus, he meets a young girl named Hanumuhn, and discovers that she's a former living deity...?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Reworld Frontier
title.native: リワールド・フロンティア＠COMIC

207962.description:
Mei had always believed that money was the most important thing in life?more important than love, relationships, or anything else. But when her apartment burnt down, leaving her with nothing but a pile of ashes, her carefully constructed world crumbled.

In her moment of despair, "Wanna stay over at my place?" Takayuki, a coworker she despises, stood before her, his offer as genuine as his gaze. His simple words were a key that unlocked her heart, melting the cold, steel armor she had built around herself for so long.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

207963.description:
Is it because we're alpha and omega? I don't even like this guy, but whenever I'm with him, my body gets hot, and I can't take my eyes off him... I want to touch him. That's... strange, isn't it?

Akari is twenty-six years old was born as the rare gender omega. On the surface, omegas are given "special treatment" due to a promotion for diversification. However, Akari still finds it hard to live in such a society. She was teased during puberty, and companies wouldn't take her seriously when she was job hunting... That's why she's giving it her all to work towards a society where everyone can live comfortably.

At Akari's company, Kaede, a national government employee, was dispatched as an advisor for the so-called "diversity promotion" to create an environment where alphas and omegas can work together.

(Source: MangaPlaza, translated)

title.english: I Don't Like You, but Let Me Touch You: Unaware Yet Destined to Be

207968.description:
Abandoned by his fellow heroes in the middle of conquering a labyrinth, assistant magician Rick is granted the all-powerful "creation magic" by a goddess in a mysterious space on his deathbed. After somehow escaping the predicament, he returns to the party, but tired of his companions' cold treatment of him, he plans to deliberately get banished. Now free, Rick is sure to enjoy life in another world, but his second life is full of troubles, including an encounter with a girl with a secret, past grudges, and a showdown with an unscrupulous merchant!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

207969.description:
A spine-chilling suspense following a man hellbent on revenge. Ryukichi Kojima was a promising young man who dreamt of making it in the professional world of shogi. However, he lost everything when six of his high school classmates started bullying him relentlessly, day after day. Years later, those same bullies have become working members of society, and are living out their best lives. But in the shadows lurks a dark figure wearing a peculiar hooded mask, observing carefully. In the figure's hand, is a notebook with the name of the boy they once tormented...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: This Isn't Revenge, He Said
title.native: 彼は『これ』は復讐ではない、と言った
title.romaji: Kare wa "Kore" wa Fukushuu de Wanai, to Itta

207970.description:
Power harassment, sexual harassment, harassment...Harassment is becoming more diverse every year and is difficult to grasp, yet it is a matter of life and death for companies and employees. It is said to cause losses of hundreds of billions to one trillion yen per year. Despite being a top business issue, there are still bosses who continue to commit it unknowingly, and employees who continue to suffer because they cannot speak up...

Inugami Shinichiro, head of the Employee Counseling Office, sniffs out all kinds of problems within the company and leads them to the optimal solution for personnel allocation. "Employee happiness is the company's profit" - what is the guidepost shown to modern working people by the "fixer" of the HR department? A socially conscious drama that is a must-read for all generations begins!!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: これってハラスメントですか?

207972.description:
Since childhood, Baek Yeonhwa’s heart belonged to only one man: her fiancé, Choi Hyun. But following their long-awaited wedding, the gentle boy she grew up with vanishes, replaced by a stranger whose intense, predatory gaze leaves her trembling. Her worst fears are realized when she discovers a dark truth: Hyun’s body has been hijacked by a powerful spirit named Mooyeong. Terrified and confused, Yeonhwa struggles to unravel when her true love disappeared, or if he ever existed at all. Yet, even as her mind breaks under the weight of the deception, Mooyeong's suffocating obsession with her only grows stronger.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Possession

207973.description:
Are you human? Or are you a beast?

The otherworldly are always watching you. From right beside you… see?

(Source: GOT Corporation, translated)

Note: Originally published as a one-shot under the title "Tengu no Yometori (天狗の嫁取り)", was then picked up for serialization.

207974.description:
The genius, eccentric, and rare talent of Natsujikei Miyazaki twists and turns literary works from East and West, creating short comics that make you laugh, cry, and learn. Masterpieces like Bushi Yo Saraba, Rashou Men, Namikaze Tachinu, Otsu no Mahoutsukai, and Kenji no Okurimono transform into prismatic colors!

(Source: Hayakawa Publishing Corp., translated)

207975.description:
Lloyd is an "advisor" who has supported the most powerful adventurers' guild from the shadows. He is able to see through people's hidden qualities and has helped many talents blossom with his accurate "advice. Unfortunately, however, he is treated as useless and banished. His fate changes when he meets Elise, a D-class magician. At first glance, she appears to have no talent, but she is a master of the elementary magic "water ball"! Before long, Lloyd founds a new guild. The idea is to gather people with unfavorable qualities and discover their talents. With the power of advice, even the most humble of players can become the strongest! The fantasy of a bottom-feeding guild's great turnaround is about to begin!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

title.native: 追放された【助言士】のギルド経営: 不遇素質持ちに助言したら、化物だらけの最強ギルドになってました
title.romaji: Tsuihou Sareta [Jogen Shi] no Guild Keiei: Fuguu Soshitu-mochi ni Jogen Shitara, Bakemono Darake no Saikyou Guild ni Nattemashita

207976.description:
A venerable duchess had her ego hijacked by an unknown entity for some time. Lupia's fiancée was taken by the Countess and she was made into a villainess, but she was able to regain her sanity when a voice said, "I will free you from the system. Even if her path to becoming the crown princess is destroyed, she will continue to pursue her own path! Here is the beginning of a fresh start as a villainess!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: Liberated From My Villainess Role! The Game Ended, so Perhaps It's Time for the Heroine's Exit

title.native: 悪役令嬢ルートから解放されました！　～ゲームは終わったので、ヒロインには退場してもらいましょうか～
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou Route kara Kaihousaremashita!: Game wa Owatta no de, Heroine ni wa Taijou shite Moraimashou ka

207977.description:
Infant formula lids, yogurt spoons... Hunsung Tech, a small-to-medium enterprise specializing in small plastic products. Peek inside, and you'll find a family (?) business where the CEO, his son, brother-in-law, younger brother, and daughter-in-law each hold a position, squeezing the life out of other employees.

Within this Hunsung Tech, Manager Lee Gyeong-Min, working in administration, is the company's ace. His sharp work ethic, early morning arrivals, and late nights are standard. He covers for the incompetence of upper management and even looks out for the treatment of production workers. After years of struggling like this, his patience reached its limit. Then, something astonishing happened in Lee Gyeong-Min's life.

Escape from the black company, job change, success, and even marriage. 99% of South Korea is made up of small and medium-sized enterprises! The fierce success story of one young man unfolding within one such SME.

(Source: Naver, translated)

207979.description:
Constantly compared to her sociable older sister, Mimosa of the noble Norton family is a young lady who shuts herself away at home with her books and embroidery. When her beautiful sister dumps her unwanted engagement onto Mimosa, she is prepared to marry a “pig of a man” with a portly physique. Instead, she finds herself welcomed with open arms in her newlywed life! A shy and flustered love story between a nervous noblewoman and a pure-hearted knight.

(Source: Manga UP!)

title.english: The Viscount’s Porky Portrait: I Married the Knight My Sister Rejected

207980.description: Born into the Hamil family, the Marquises of the Kingdom of Warren, Narsadia was shunned by her own parents because of her appearance. Meanwhile, her twin sister Beatrice, known as the 'Fairy Princess', was so beautiful that she monopolised the love of her parents. Narsadia is deemed to be a source of uncertainty for Beatrice's future and is imprisoned in a tower. One day, Narsadia, who is enduring despair and surviving patiently, is visited by Timis, Prince of the Empire...!

207982.description:
“I would like you to become my lover.” Daughter of a viscount, Freya Villiers was being pressured into taking back her ex-fiance, Nathan, after their engagement was broken off due to him cheating on Freya with her sister. In order to flee her parents, who are all for her reconciliation with Nathan, she visits Count Bloodbury, feared by the nobles as a “vampire.” With nothing to lose, she asks him to pretend to be her lover and…?!

(Source: K MANGA)
synonyms: I Fell into a Situationship with the Vampire Count?!

207983.description:
After years of unrequited love, Angelica finally marries Lord Dominic, but he remains cold and distant. To make matters worse, Angelica’s uncle selfishly betrays the family. As endless debt and sorrow pain the poor girl, she tragically decides to end it all... Yet, she somehow wakes up in the past, returning to the day she proposed to Dominic. Was it all a dream? One thing is clear—Angelica won’t commit the same mistakes again.

“I don’t love you anymore, Dominic. Let’s break off the engagement!”

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

207984.description:
Kim Ha-Shin, a low-ranking guardian god, is determined to make his town the happiest there is and get promoted to a higher rank. But his plan goes awry when Nam Da-Reum, a girl with an extremely low happiness level and no will to live, moves to town. Now Hashin must do everything in his power to make Da-Reum happy so that he can save her and everything he's worked for. As hardships and obstacles continue to mount, will Ha-Shin manage to help Da-Reum find true joy in life and put his town back on top?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: An Extraordinary Guardian

207985.description:
A loser streamer with a past is chosen by a D-cup baddie guardian spirit.

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Soulmate: Remember Me

207986.description:
What kind of ‘filter’ do we use when we speak?

Goh Dam, a timid college student who always hid her true feelings, collapses on the street one day and disappears. A year later, she reappears. She reveals she has contracted a rare disease called ‘Rayleigh Syndrome’... What? A disease where your true feelings burst out? Through words that both wound and comfort, she navigates her unfiltered, tumultuous youth.

(Source: Naver, translated)

207987.description:
Eun-Ha, who had set out on a journey, encounters a mysterious boy named San-Ho being chased by a stranger there. She barely manages to escape with San-Ho, but a month later, San-Ho dies right before Eun-Ha's eyes. Eun-Ha flees back to Korea, and 17 years later, a man resembling the deceased San-Ho appears before her. The man introduces himself as Shin Noel, but he overlaps with San-Ho in far too many ways. Could he really not be San-Ho? Or is he San-Ho? A story of searching for you even within distorted memories. Remember me.

(Source: Naver, translated)

207988.description:
Yuya Shirasaki is a weak Awakened with no Natural Skill--a fact that causes his death in Earth’s final apocalyptic monster invasion in 2034. But when he opens his eyes again, he finds himself 10 years in the past and poised to use his knowledge of the future to save Arisa Miyanaga, a similarly weak guildmate. Doing so unlocks his Unique Skill, Akashic Records, which gives him perfect knowledge of any dungeon. However, the guildmaster of his old guild seeks to hasten a catastrophic monster attack, which Yuya must stop. Can he save the world this time around?

(Source: WEBTOON)

This relationship between us, advancing slowly, bit by bit.

A special feeling that doesn't have an obvious name like “love” or “romance” attached to it—

(Source: chico*books, translated)

207990.description:
The reincarnated heroine, Lunalise, finds her potential lover, the prince, stolen away by a villainous young lady, and before she knows it, she's been expelled from school! With only the weakest "blessing" ability, Lunalise is quickly at a loss. Then, King Bercrece, the White Wolf Chloelide, appears before her. He tells Luna to become his personal Jewel Blesser...!? I've decided to live for my work, so please leave me alone!

A heart-pounding work fantasy that begins with Lunalise being reincarnated as the heroine and then expelled from school!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Lady Victoria Winner is about to have her engagement to Prince Frederic called off. Any other noble lady would cry or lash out, but not Victoria. Instead, she decides that she will simply not allow it. Whether it be broken engagements, assassination attempts, or plots against her from the nobility, there is nothing that the great Victoria cannot overcome! Welcome to the most majestic of romcoms!

(Source: K MANGA)
